title: Are you a Flight Instructor? Explore Multiple Career Paths at Greybird, no matter your level.
description:
GreyBird Pilot Academy is expanding and is looking for Flight Instructors to join our team fulltime or parttime in Denmark.

Are you passionate about training and developing the next generation of commercial pilots? Do you thrive in a professional aviation environment where you can combine flight instruction with classroom and simulator-based teaching?

Three profile opportunities

Whether you are a newly graduated or an experienced Flight Instructor, already hold CRI/SPA privileges, or are ready to take the next step through our sponsored development program, we offer exciting opportunities to build your aviation career while helping future pilots achieve their goals:

Career Path 1: Flight Instructor DK summer / Spain winther

About the Role

As a Flight Instructor, your primary responsibility will be delivering flight training onboard our aircraft. Depending on operational needs, you may also conduct simulator sessions and classroom-based theoretical instruction.

You will guide students throughout their training journey and help ensure the highest standards of pilot education.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • Valid Flight Instructor Certificate (FI

  • Set to have a split base between Denmark in the summer and Spain in the winter

  • Based in either DK or Spain

Read more and apply here

Career Path 2: Flight Instructor – Sponsored CRI/SPA Program

About the Role

This position is designed for pilots who meet the requirements for CRI/SPA training but have not yet obtained the qualification.

As a Flight Instructor, you will deliver flight training, simulator instruction, and classroom teaching while participating in our sponsored development pathway.

Sponsored Development Opportunity

GreyBird will sponsor the CRI/SPA training required for the role if you meet the eligibility criteria below.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for sponsorship for a full-time position based at Aarhus Airport in Denmark, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • Experience as PIC on MEP aircraft

  • Meet EASA FCL requirements for:

  • CRI/SPA ME, or

  • IRI MEP

Read more and apply here

Career Path 3: Flight Instructor CRI/SPA/(ME) (fulltime / or flexible planned partime)

About the Role

This position is aimed at experienced instructors already holding CRI/SPA qualifications.

You will primarily conduct flight training and may also deliver simulator and classroom instruction as part of our integrated training programs.

For candidates with these qualifications, GreyBird offers a full-time position or a flexible employment for candidates who are interested in a combination of working as an instructor at GreyBird and an airline job or commute between residence and Aarhus airport.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • CRI/SPA qualification (mandatory)

  • ME qualification (preferred but not required)

  • Valid Flight Instructor Certificate (FI)

Read more and apply here

Ready for Take-Off?

If you meet the requirements for one of the three career paths, we encourage you to apply for the position that matches your current qualifications.

Join GreyBird Pilot Academy and help shape the future of aviation.

We can’t wait to hear from you.

Relocation: Candidates must be willing to relocate and live within commuting distance of our base in Aarhus, DK fulltime or parttime depending on the position.

title: Allround-håndværker søges til fast ansættelse/All-round tradesperson wanted for full-time position
description:
Dansk:

Vi søger en erfaren og ansvarsbevidst allround-håndværker, som har primært erfaring og gode faglige kompetencer inden for tømrer- og malerfaget.

Arbejdsopgaverne vil blandt andet omfatte tømrerarbejde og mindre renoveringsopgaver, opbygning og afretning af undergulve, lægning af klikgulve, lamelgulve og massive trægulve samt montering af lister, paneler, aflslibning af trægulve og behandling af trægulve. Derudover vil arbejdet bestå af spartling, opsætning af filt og maling af vægge, lofter og træværk.

Der kan også forekomme reparationer, vedligeholdelse og forskellige mindre håndværksopgaver, som kan berøre eller trække på andre håndværksfag.

Vi leder efter en fagligt dygtig og alsidig person med relevant brancheerfaring. Du skal kunne arbejde selvstændigt, tage ansvar for dine opgaver og levere et pænt resultat med fokus på kvalitet og detaljer.

Du skal kunne kommunikere på dansk eller engelsk. Kørekort er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Vi tilbyder fast fuldtidsansættelse med ordnede forhold, løn efter kvalifikationer og varierede opgaver i Storkøbenhavn og Nordsjælland. Du bliver en del af en virksomhed med et godt arbejdsmiljø, hvor samarbejde, ansvarlighed og høj faglig kvalitet vægtes højt.

Arbejdstiden er som udgangspunkt mandag til fredag kl. 7.00–15.00. Opstart hurtigst muligt eller efter aftale.

Hvis stillingen lyder som noget for dig, bedes du sende en kort ansøgning og dit CV til info@gp-byggeservice.dk.

English:

We are looking for an experienced and responsible all-round tradesperson with strong practical skills and experience, primarily within carpentry and painting.

The work will include carpentry and minor renovation projects, building and levelling subfloors, installing click flooring, engineered flooring and solid wooden floors, as well as fitting trims, skirting boards, floor sanding and floor coating. The position will also involve filling, installing wall lining and painting walls, ceilings and woodwork.

There may also be various repair and maintenance tasks, as well as smaller assignments involving other building trades.

We are looking for a skilled and versatile professional with relevant industry experience. You must be able to work independently, take responsibility for your assignments and deliver high-quality results with attention to detail.

You must be able to communicate in Danish or English. A valid driver’s licence is an advantage but not a requirement.

We offer permanent full-time employment with proper working conditions, salary based on qualifications and varied projects across Greater Copenhagen and North Zealand. You will join a company with a positive working environment where teamwork, responsibility and professional quality are highly valued.

Working hours are generally Monday to Friday from 7:00 to 15:00. The position is available for an immediate start or by agreement.

If this position sounds suitable for you, please send a short application and your CV to info@gp-byggeservice.dk.

title: Senior Immersion Engineer
description:
Join a project that’s not just exciting—it’s world-changing! We’re looking for talented individuals to be part of something truly remarkable. If you’re driven by challenge and the chance to make a lasting impact, this is the perfect place for you. Don’t just be a part of the future—help create it.

About FLC:

At Femern Link Contractors (FLC), we are responsible for designing and constructing the immersed tunnel, portals and ramps on both ends of the tunnel, in Rødbyhavn and Puttgarden.

We are also building the facilities for prefabricating tunnel elements as well as accommodation facilities, also known as the “Tunnel village” in Rødbyhavn, which provides housing for FLC workers.

About the department:

The immersion engineering team is looking for a naval architect, maritime engineer or offshore engineer to strengthen the team. Immersion engineering is taking care of all calculations regarding tunnel elements float up (weight analysis, determine ballast concrete and water, longitudinal section forces, floating stability), transfers in basins and harbor (winch operations with or without vessel assistance), mooring of the tunnel elements, transport to offshore location, immersion (including but not limited to dynamic analyses) and the stability of the elements after immersion.

As an Immersion Engineer, you will participate in the team responsible for floating up and/or hoisting the concrete tunnel elements, equipping them in the port and then transporting and installing them at sea. In the first phase you will participate in the preparation of this crucial operation, by making ballast plans e.g.. In the second phase, you will be part of the operational team that does the immersion work, assisting the Immersion Master by giving technical advice.

Main tasks and responsibilities:

  • During the preparatory phase, you are responsible for the ballast plans and float up calculations.

  • You take part in the interface management with other departments within FLC regarding specific parts of the T&I scope

  • You will coordinate part of the design scope between Work Preparations and the design team based in the Netherlands

  • You are involved in the management/operation of Tunnel Control Systems

  • You ensure the conclusions and results from the design documents are correctly taken over in the work method statements, drawings and operation manuals for the Immersion Pontoon specific operations related to the overall transport and immersion scope

  • You liaise with the Marine Warranty Surveyor and contribute to the work procedures, Go/No Go procedures

  • During float up and ballasting you check if the operations stay within boundary conditions and act accordingly

  • During the execution phase, you advise during the transport and installation of the elements. You will be present in the command unit of the immersion pontoons during offshore operations.

  • You will do checks during execution, monitor the immersion process, and have an advisory role to the one in charge of the operation. You are also prepared and ready to deal with contingencies if any might occur

  • After immersion, you will do checks on data to create lessons learned for next operations

Qualifications:

  • You are a qualified naval architect/maritime engineer/offshore engineer with minimum of 7 years experience

  • You have prior experience with immersion of large structures or offshore lifting operations

  • You have a good understanding of stability calculations, mooring calculations and hydrodynamics

  • You are a hands-on problem solver and a decision maker

  • You are a team player with strong communication skills

  • You find it a challenge to work in a international, multi-cultural work-environment in which communication and team spirit is key to success

  • You are fluent in English.

Conditions: 

FLC considers transparent management structures, short decision-making channels, and a team-oriented environment to be extremely important. The FLC staff is expected to set themselves targets, achieve them independently, and take responsibility for their actions – irrespective of their position in the company.

Full time employment with health insurance and lunch arrangement available upon request.

Workplace:

Based in Rødbyhavn.

Application:

We look forward to receiving your application (in English) as soon as possible and. Applications received will be processed on an ongoing basis, and we will complete the recruitment once we have found the right profile.

title: Site Engineer, Mechanical for Renewables; Location: Denmark , DK - Esbjerg, DK - Aarhus, Worldwide
description:
If you are as passionate about sustainability and the green transition as we are, then this is a great opportunity for you to join an international company in growth as our new Site Engineer, Mechanical for our Renewables Division!
 
Your position 

As our new Site Engineer, Mechanical at Semco Maritime you will join an experienced, highly skilled and passionate team of engineers in our Renewables division. This team has been responsible for creating one of the largest project portfolios within offshore substations worldwide.

At Semco Maritime safety is a core value, and in this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering innovative solutions. Above all, your work will make a real change for the global energy sector. 
We are working on sites globally in our markets, including Europe, Asia and the USA. So, traveling work is the standard and we work both offshore and onshore.

Your tasks & responsibilities 

You will be involved in the construction of offshore substation for windfarms and distribution/transmission projects world-wide. You, together with your team will be responsible for installations, tests, and commissioning of mechanical systems such as ventilation systems, cooling systems, fire extinguishing system, diesel generator system and fuel system.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to: 

  • Coordinating and managing daily site activities for 4-10 skilled workers
  • Ensuring that the project activities adhere to the schedule and activities are planned accordingly
  • Coordinate and plan with installation suppliers / yard / partners
  • Purchase and overseeing the timely delivery of materials and coordination with vendors
  • Plan and align with Engineering department on changes in design and/or other topics
  • Ad-hoc daily tasks and problem solving
  • Run and manage start-up and commissioning of mechanical systems

Your profile & qualifications 

We imagine that you are an ambitious and talented professional with a keen eye for detail. You are also a dedicated team player with a positive attitude as well as good commercial awareness and managerial skills.
 
To succeed in this position, we expect that you:
  • Preferred to have a master’s or bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, marine engineering or similar
  • Have prior hands-on experience with some of the mechanical systems
  • Have experience working with staff and supplier contracts
  • Possess a safety-first mindset
  • Would like to work in an international setting where a lot of traveling is required to go to the sites
  • Have effective interpersonal skills and great communication skills in English

Welcome to Semco Maritime 
At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape. 

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. 
Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future. 

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.  
We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.   
Care to join the movement? 

Change. With us.

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

title: Senior Research Adviser for EU, International Funding, Innovation and Impact, Faculty of Health Sciences
description:
Are you curious about how FP10 will change the opportunities and requirements facing universities? Are you interested in the growing expectations for innovation and impact arising from research? And would you like to work both strategically and closely with researchers and projects, with one clear objective: to strengthen SUND’s international position and secure more external funding?

Then you could play a central role in SUND Research Support. We are looking for an experienced research adviser who from 1 December 2026 can serve as our key specialist for EU and international funding opportunities – and help prepare the unit for tomorrow’s requirements in relation to funding, project delivery, innovation and societal impact.

Responsibilities
You will take an overview of EU and international funding: from developments in Horizon Europe and FP10 to specific calls, partnerships and opportunities for SUND researchers. You will translate policy and programme developments into action and help us position ourselves early as new agendas emerge.

The role spans strategic intelligence and portfolio oversight through to hands-on advice and coordination of prioritised initiatives. Some days you will work on long-term EU positioning and pipeline development; on others, closely with a researcher, an international consortium or a specific call. We do not expect you to do everything yourself, but you will need to spot opportunities, bring together the right expertise and drive progress.

Innovation and impact are important parts of the role. You will strengthen our impact-upfront approach and ensure that requirements relating to involvement, uptake, implementation and knowledge valorisation are considered early. At the same time, you will contribute to a smooth transition from pre-award to post-award, so that project delivery is considered from the outset and lessons from funded projects and project implementation feed into new applications.

You will be both a key contributor to specific EU and international initiatives and a co-developer of our shared models, workflows and portfolio overview. The aim is a more coherent approach to international funding – not simply more individual applications.

Qualifications
We are looking for an experienced professional who thrives at the intersection of research, EU policy, funding, innovation and impact. You have solid experience of EU or international funding, research development or research support, and a good knowledge of Horizon Europe or other major international programmes.

You work strategically and analytically but are also keen to turn insight into tangible results. You are a strong coordinator and relationship-builder who can navigate complex processes, bring together expertise and build trust with researchers, colleagues and management. You communicate confidently in both Danish and English.
It is an advantage if you also have experience of areas such as EU policy, international consortia, Brussels networks, post-award, innovation, societal impact or knowledge valorisation. We do not expect you to be an expert in all of these areas. A PhD or other research experience may be an advantage but is not essential.

In addition, you have an understanding of and a desire to work with digitalization and artificial intelligence (AI) in relation to optimizing processes and creating value within the organization. 

About SUND Research Support and the Faculty of Health Sciences
SUND Research Support assists researchers at the Faculty of Health Sciences at SDU from the early idea and funding opportunity through to application, project delivery, innovation and impact.

We aim to work more proactively with funding intelligence, positioning, partnerships and long-term pipelines – and to create stronger links between pre-award, post-award, innovation and impact. At the same time, we want to use data, organisational learning and AI more systematically.

You will have the opportunity both to work directly with researchers and projects and to help shape how a modern research support function should operate in the years ahead. You will play a central role in SUND’s international funding activities in the run-up to FP10 and help create stronger links between EU/international funding, post-award, innovation and impact.

You will work closely with strong health sciences research environments, management teams and colleagues with a range of specialist profiles. We are interested in new ways of working and in how data, digital tools and AI can add value to research support. This is an opportunity both to deliver results today and to help shape how we work tomorrow.

The Faculty of Health Sciences at the University of Southern Denmark is one of Denmark’s leading faculties of health sciences. With nine departments, internationally top‑class research, and a broad range of health‑related study programmes, we contribute to developing the knowledge, treatments, and healthcare system of the future.
As an employee at the faculty, you become part of an ambitious and interdisciplinary environment characterised by high academic standards, strong collaborations, and excellent opportunities for professional development. The faculty has activities in Odense, Esbjerg, and Copenhagen. In Esbjerg and Copenhagen, strong academic communities provide the framework for research and education, while our modern faculty building in Odense brings research, education, and administration together under one roof and is directly connected to Odense University Hospital.

Read more about the Faculty of Health Sciences here.

Contact
If you would like more information about the position, you are welcome to contact head of SUND Research Support Anne Kathrine Overgaard, tlf. 60111043, e-mail: aovergaard@health.sdu.dk or Head of Education and Secretariat Merete Munk på mmunk@health.sdu.dk.

Application Process
The application deadline is 29 September 2026 at 11:59 PM. We expect to conduct interviews 7 October 2026. 

Employment starts on 1 December 2026 or as soon as possible thereafter.

Salary and Terms of Employment
Your place of employment will be the University of Southern Denmark in Odense, Campusvej 55, 5230 Odense M.

There may be limited travel activity to other SDU campus cities.

Employment is in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and collective agreement for academics (AC).

The position is full time.

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements.

As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range of the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process.
SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. 

If you are interested in the position, you must submit an application that includes a cover letter, CV indicating months and years (without photo), and diploma. All documents related to the application should not contain photos or CPR numbers – if so, the CPR number must be redacted.

All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. The cover letter and CV must not exceed 5 MB.

Guidance on the application process can be found here.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding society and therefore encourages all qualified applicants, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.

About SDU
The University of Southern Denmark exists to create value for and with society. Whether our contribution comes in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education, or learning, we aim to make a positive difference for society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by nurturing talent and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops, and recruits talent. At the same time, we must ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. It is the university’s researchers, teachers, students, leaders, and technical-administrative staff who form the foundation of our success.

Salary and employment conditions

title: Senior Software Engineer! Build production software – and raise the engineering bar around you
description:
If your definition of seniority is more than simply having written code for many years, this could be interesting.

Cubris develops software that helps rail operators run smarter, safer and more sustainable railway services.

As part of Hitachi Rail, we are now strengthening our engineering organisation and developing Cubris into a high-performing technology competence centre around our GreenSpeed® platform.

We are therefore looking for a Senior Software Engineer who combines strong hands-on development skills with technical ownership.

This is not a role where you receive a Jira ticket, implement it and move on.

You will take ownership of delivery within a product area – from understanding requirements and making implementation decisions to coordinating development, identifying risks and getting robust software into production.

What you will do

You will:

  • Design, develop and ship production-grade software

  • Translate requirements into clear technical tasks and solutions

  • Take ownership of technical execution within a product area

  • Coordinate development across multiple engineers when required

  • Identify dependencies, blockers and technical risks before they affect delivery

  • Challenge unclear requirements constructively

  • Participate actively in design discussions and technical reviews

  • Design and document architecture at component level

  • Develop and maintain release pipelines

  • Work closely with Product and Quality Engineering

  • Support colleagues through technical sparring, reviews and coaching

  • Improve code quality, testability, maintainability and delivery practices

The role is deliberately broader than coding alone. Cubris expects senior engineers to take responsibility for outcomes, not just assigned tasks.

What you bring

We are looking for substantial software engineering experience and a strong track record of taking software from requirements into production.

Your technical foundation should include:

  • Strong C#/.NET experience

  • Docker/container experience

  • Azure DevOps Cloud

  • Solid software design fundamentals

  • Testing and code-quality practices

  • CI/CD and modern delivery workflows

  • Debugging and performance thinking

  • Database and data-access experience

Experience with .NET MAUI, Blazor, Android/device-based UI or embedded UI solutions is relevant for parts of the GreenSpeed® environment and would be an advantage.

But technical skills alone are not enough.

You should also be comfortable creating momentum when requirements are ambiguous, making sound engineering decisions and helping other developers become better. The formal role description specifically calls for experience leading technical initiatives without necessarily having formal people-management responsibility.

Why Cubris?

You join at a point where your experience can make a visible difference.

You will work close to Product, Quality Engineering and experienced technical colleagues while helping define the standards, tools and engineering practices of the organisation Cubris is becoming.

You get:

  • A technically meaningful product

  • Direct influence on engineering decisions

  • A focused Danish technology environment

  • International reach through Hitachi Rail

  • The opportunity to help build the engineering culture rather than simply become part of an established one

Location: Ballerup, Denmark
Company: Cubris – a Hitachi Rail company

Interested?

Reach out for an informal and confidential conversation.

Please note that work permit needs to be in place before applying and that there is no relocation package included. You must be able to commute to the office in Ballerup every work day.

title: Tech Lead! 50% Lead Developer. 50% Software Architect. 100% technical leadership.
description:
Are you the engineer people turn to when the code is difficult, the architecture matters and the team needs a technical direction?

Cubris is strengthening its engineering organisation around GreenSpeed® as part of our ambition to build a high-performing technology competence centre for intelligent railway solutions within Hitachi Rail.

We are looking for a Tech Lead who combines deep hands-on software engineering with architectural judgement.

This is deliberately not a traditional management role.

You will spend approximately 50% of your time as a Lead Developer and 50% as a Software Architect – building production software, solving difficult engineering problems and coaching developers while also representing your team in the Architecture Group and translating architectural direction into practical solutions.

Your role as Lead Developer

You will:

  • Write and ship production code

  • Take ownership of technically complex stories

  • Unblock other engineers when problems become difficult

  • Coach developers through pairing, design discussions and high-quality PR reviews

  • Raise standards for automated testing and CI/CD

  • Improve pipeline reliability and engineering effectiveness

  • Strengthen observability through logs, metrics and traces

  • Drive systematic reduction of technical debt

  • Establish useful patterns, runbooks and reference implementations

In other words: you are expected to remain technically credible because you are still doing the work.

Your role as Software Architect

At the same time, you will:

  • Represent your team in Cubris’ Architecture Group

  • Translate architectural decisions and ADRs into practical team standards

  • Define service boundaries, APIs, events and data contracts

  • Establish and verify non-functional requirements around security, reliability, performance and cost

  • Lead technical migrations and integrations

  • Manage architectural dependencies and compatibility

  • Maintain architectural documentation, roadmaps and decision records

You become the technical bridge between Product, Engineering and Architecture.

What you bring

We expect you to have:

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience

  • Experience leading technical initiatives or engineering teams

  • Strong C#/.NET expertise

  • Experience designing distributed systems and/or microservices

  • Good SQL/NoSQL fundamentals

  • Experience with APIs, domain modelling and event-driven architectures

  • Strong understanding of CI/CD and modern software delivery

  • Experience with cloud technologies, containers and orchestration

  • An engineering mindset around reliability, observability, security and performance

  • The ability to mentor developers and communicate technical decisions clearly

The current environment includes C#/.NET, .NET Core, Entity Framework, MS SQL Server, Azure DevOps, Git, CI/CD and Visual Studio, with Azure, Kubernetes and Infrastructure-as-Code increasingly relevant.

Why Cubris?

Because you will have unusually visible technical influence.

You will not simply inherit somebody else's engineering system. You will help define how Cubris builds software: the architecture, engineering practices, quality standards and technical guardrails that enable the organisation to scale.

And the software has a tangible purpose: helping make modern railway operations smarter, more predictable and more energy-efficient.

Location: Ballerup, Denmark
Department: Software Production
Reports to: Development Manager

Interested?

Reach out for an informal and confidential conversation.

Please note that work permit needs to be in place before applying and that there is no relocation package included. You must be able to commute to the office in Ballerup every work day.

title: Chef- Zoku Copenhagen
description:
Are you a passionate chef with great cooking skills who loves to work in an open kitchen? Then keep reading.

Zoku provides a home for business travellers who want to live in a city for between a few days and a few months. We’re a new type of hotel offering a relaxed place to live, co-work and socialize – while wiring residents into the local scene. Join an international team of driven, proactive and fun-loving Zokus who all have one thing in common: a passion for connecting people across the globe.

TELL ME MORE

Life doesn’t become more social than through sharing food. That’s our founding food philosophy and it can be yours too. The food that comes out of our Living Kitchen is fresh, simple, honest, healthy and local. With short-end preparation times, simple ingredients and limited preparation steps, our assortment is incredibly intelligent and facilitates fast service.

As our new chef you'll be responsible for any food that comes out of our Living Kitchen. You'll plate beautiful dishes and at times make creative buffets that not only look good, but also taste amazing.

You’ll work closely together with our team of chefs, to develop menu offerings and forecast supply needs. You like to take on responsibility, thrive with independence in your work and function as a substitute for our chefs. 

WHAT MAKES OUR KITCHEN UNIQUE?

  • You won’t hide in the background. You'll get to work in an open kitchen environment with plenty of space and natural daylight.

  • You'll get the ultimate flexibility. You can come up with your own dishes and let your creativity run wild.

  • You can have good conversations with visitors. You’re the face of the kitchen and you'll get to directly chat with guests.

  • You get to be independent in your work. You like doing your own thing and can cook solo when you need to.

  • You can get to know the entire team. You'll be in close contact with our front of house and the entire Zoku team.

  • You can work in a unique kitchen setup. We’re not like your average kitchen (feel free to stop by our rooftop to see for yourself!).

  • You are encouraged to work with fresh and seasonal ingredients. We put a strong emphasis on incorporating vegetables into our dishes.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

  • A market conform salary package including pension and health insurance.

  • Cool benefits like an after-work drink, access to all community events, various discounts like 40% discount on F&B for you and 4 friends, plus Employee and Friends & Family rates in all Zoku Locations.  

  • A free night stay for you and your +1 in your first 3 months at your Zoku (dinner & breakfast) and a free night at any Zoku location for your birthday, including welcome drink & breakfast to experience Zoku as a true guest. 

  • No boring canteen!! Staff meals enjoyed from our Living Kitchen.

  • A personal budget unlocked after 1 year at Zoku to spend on extra days off, learning & development, extra cash or discounted vouchers. 

  • A fun, young, and international team to grow with. Plus, exciting training and events to celebrate every step of the journey!

  • A job at one of the 25 coolest hotels in the world, that feels like a second home and is purpose-driven.

WE LOVE PEOPLE WHO...

  • Show their creativity through their passion for food and never settle for less.

  • Can juggle many tasks at the same time while remaining cool headed and warm hearted.

  • Enjoy variety in their day and are happy to switch things up, whether that means breakfast, brunch, lunch buffets, a la carte dinners or cheffing up something special for our Meetings & Events.

  • Have experience in working independently and don't believe in traditional kitchen hierarchies.

  • Enjoy working in an open kitchen and love to chat up a storm with our residents.

  • Have experience in healthy homestyle cooking – vegetarian cooking skills are a plus.

  • Have provable knowledge of various cooking techniques.

A FEW MUST HAVES

  • You have a minimum of 1 year working experience in a kitchen or restaurant environment. 

  • You have experience with implementing the local HACCP guidelines (Hygiejnebevis).

  • You are fluent in English – Danish and other languages are a plus.

  • You are an EU resident or have a working and living permit valid for Denmark including a CPR.

  • You are fully flexible, as there won't be fixed working days / hours, including availability on some weekends. Shifts include AM, Mid-shifts, and PM.

  • You love to work as we'll need you Full Time (37 hours- 5 shifts weekly)

  • Available to start As Soon As Possible.

WHAT WE ARE PROUD OF 

Our fresh take on hospitality has been recognized around the world with plenty of press attention and design awards.

We’re also proudly B Corp certified at all four of our locations (Amsterdam, Copenhagen, Paris and Vienna), which means we hold ourselves to high standards when it comes to social and environmental impact, transparency and accountability.

WHAT IS ZOKU

Zoku is a new type of hotel that offers a place to live, co-work and socialize in Europe's most livable cities: Amsterdam, Vienna, Copenhagen & Paris. 

Designed for the new generation of travellers, Zoku is so much more than a long stay hotel. It is a place you can call your second home, even on your first visit. Zoku is a hive of private Lofts and rooftop Social Spaces, so travellers can stay connected and well rested as they live and work throughout Europe. Throw yourself into your work and play, and effortlessly discover one of our home cities.

title: Senior Sourcing Specialist
description:
Job titleSenior Sourcing SpecialistJob description:

At BeGreen, we develop and operate renewable energy projects built to last across generations.

We are looking for a commercially driven Senior Sourcing Specialist with a strong background in renewables to lead sourcing activities and commercial contracting across solar, hybrid, and energy storage projects based in Denmark, with exposure to international suppliers and projects.

This position is ideal for someone who understands the unique sourcing and commercial challenges of renewable energy, whether in solar, BESS, or hybrid technologies—and who knows that the right supplier relationships and contracts are what make or break a project. Broader experience in energy infrastructure, construction, or adjacent industries is equally welcome, and will add valuable perspective to our team.

About the role

You will take ownership of sourcing strategies, supplier engagement, and contract execution across the full renewable energy project lifecycle. Working closely with Project Management, Engineering, Construction, Sustainability, Cyber Security, HSE, and Legal, you will ensure that commercial decisions drive project performance and long-term value.

Your hands-on knowledge of the renewables market—its key suppliers, technology trends, cost drivers, and contractual complexities—will be a distinct advantage in this role. Whether you're navigating a large EPC tender for a solar park, structuring a BESS supply agreement, or evaluating a new contractor in an emerging market, your sector insight will be central to how you work.

Beyond large and complex tenders, you will also support pragmatic sourcing for lower-value purchases, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and speed without compromising quality or governance.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end competitive tenders for major renewable energy packages, including planning, evaluation, negotiation, and contract award
  • Develop and execute sourcing strategies specifically tailored to solar parks, hybrid plants, and battery energy storage systems
  • Leverage renewables market knowledge to drive supplier assessments, benchmark pricing, and identify strategic sourcing opportunities
  • Lead commercial negotiations with energy suppliers and contractors, with a strong focus on risk management and contract robustness
  • Manage both complex, high-value sourcing processes and agile lower-value purchasing activities (RFQs, call-offs, POs)
  • Prepare decision-making materials, including total cost of ownership analyses with a clear understanding of energy project cost structures
  • Support early contract management, including supplier onboarding, performance tracking, and risk assessments
  • Contribute market intelligence on renewable energy supply chains to strengthen category strategies and long-term supplier partnerships

What you bring

We are looking for someone with a solid commercial background, and we particularly value:

  • Direct sourcing or commercial experience in solar, BESS, hybrid energy, wind or other renewable technologies
  • Familiarity with key renewable energy suppliers, EPC contractors, and technology providers
  • Understanding of the commercial and technical dynamics specific to utility-scale renewable projects

Broader energy & infrastructure experience (also highly valued):

  • Experience in conventional energy, oil & gas, transmission, or large-scale infrastructure procurement
  • Background in complex project environments with multi-stakeholder commercial interfaces
  • Exposure to long-term contracts, framework agreements, and supplier performance management

In addition, you bring:

  • Confidence in leading negotiations and managing commercial interfaces
  • A structured, proactive, and ownership-driven approach to work
  • Strong stakeholder management and clear communication skills
  • Knowledge of EU procurement regulations (Utilities Directive) or the motivation to build it
  • Fluency in English; proficiency in Danish or Swedish is a plus
  • Relocation packages are not available for this role and a valid Danish work- and residence permit is a precondition

The team you will join

You will join BeGreen's Procurement team, a group of specialists working across category management, sourcing, and contract management. We collaborate closely, share knowledge openly, and prioritize integrity in both processes and relationships.

What we offer

  • A key role in shaping sourcing practices at a fast-growing renewable energy company
  • Influence across the full project lifecycle—from early development through construction to operations
  • A collaborative, international work environment with passionate and ambitious colleagues
  • A strong focus on professional development and continuous learning
  • Office based in Carlsberg Byen, Copenhagen.


About BeGreen

BeGreen develops, builds, and operates onshore energy facilities – primarily solar, wind, and battery solutions. We are around 60 colleagues from diverse backgrounds. We design our projects to work in practice – technically, commercially, and in interaction with local communities.

BeGreen is headquartered in Denmark and is part of Equinor, an international energy company. This provides a strong foundation and access to experience and competencies across markets.

Our values: collaboration, integrity and ambition are applied to our projects, decisions, and the way we work together internally and externally.

title: Operating Partner & General Manager (Profit Sharing & Equity)
description:
Operating Partner & General Manager – RAY'S Chicken

We run RAY'S Chicken at Hejrevej in Nordvest, sharing a roof and a taproom with Gamma Brewing. We take a lot of pride in what we do: 24-hour buttermilk marinades, custom spice rubs, homemade sauces, and fried chicken that stands out in Copenhagen.

We are ready to build RAY'S into a multi-location brand. To do that, we need a partner on the ground to take over the daily operation of our flagship location, dial in our systems, and build the foundation for our next openings.

This role comes with base pay, direct profit sharing, and an equity track.

What the Job Looks Like

You will start on the floor. To run and expand this business, you need to understand every moving part firsthand.

  • Step 1: Learn the Shop You'll spend your first weeks working the line—prepping chicken, running the fryers, packing orders, handling Wolt and takeaway rushes, and talking to guests.

  • Step 2: Take Full Ownership of Hejrevej Once you know the rhythm of the place, you take the reins of day-to-day operations: scheduling the crew, ordering from suppliers, keeping food costs tight, staying on top of Fødevarestyrelsen hygiene standards, and making sure the food quality never slips.

  • Step 3: Build for Expansion You'll help turn our daily workflows into clear, repeatable routines so that training new staff is easy. When we are ready to open location number two, you will be deeply involved in site setup, hiring, and launch.

Who We Are Looking For

You do not need years of high-end restaurant experience. If you have run a busy kitchen or managed a bar, great. But if your background is in retail, small business, logistics, or running physical projects and you love fast-paced, hands-on work, we want to hear from you.

Here is what actually matters to us:

  • High Agency: You don't wait for someone to tell you what needs fixing. If a station is dirty, an order is delayed, or inventory is running low, you jump in and solve it.

  • Comfortable on Your Feet:  You enjoy the energy of a packed Friday night shift and you lead your team by working alongside them.

  • Organized & Practical: You notice small details. You can build simple checklists, manage inventory without wasting stock, and keep a kitchen running cleanly under pressure.

  • Good with People: You stay calm and constructive when the ticket machine is going non-stop and the room is full. You treat your team with respect and set a solid pace.

  • Long-Term Mindset: You want to build something real and share in the financial upside through profit distribution and equity as the business grows.

The Deal

  • Compensation: Base salary after experience with a road map to profit sharing.

  • Equity Pathway: Clear, milestone-based equity vesting as you take full operational ownership and we expand.

title: Kom og bliv en del af Danmarks førende krisecenter  Krisecenter Guldborgsund søger en erfaren socialrådgiver til en fast stilling
description:
Brænder du for at gøre en reel forskel for mennesker, der har været udsat for vold i nære relationer?

Kan du kombinere høj socialfaglighed med empati, struktur og handlekraft, og trives du i en hverdag, hvor ikke to dage er ens?

Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

På Krisecenter Guldborgsund arbejder vi hver dag for at skabe sikkerhed, nye handlemuligheder og en vej videre for mennesker, der har været udsat for vold i nære relationer. Vi er et hus i rivende udvikling, og vi har høje ambitioner, både på vores beboeres og vores fagligheds vegne.

Hvem er vi?

Krisecenter Guldborgsund har 21 lejligheder med plads til voksne og op mod 30 medfølgende børn, og sommetider også familiens kæledyr.

Fælles for vores beboere er, at de har været udsat for vold i nære relationer og derfor har søgt ophold hos os.

Vi er et stort hus, hvor der sker meget i løbet af en dag. Det kræver, at du kan bevare overblikket, være fleksibel og samtidig holde fast i struktur, faglighed og dokumentation.

Hos os arbejder vi tæt sammen på tværs af fagligheder, fordi vi tror på, at den bedste indsats skabes, når forskellige perspektiver bringes i spil.

Din rolle som rådgiver

Som rådgiver får du en central rolle i den enkelte borgers ophold og forløb på krisecenteret.

Arbejdet spænder fra den første visitation og vurdering af sikkerhedsbehov til samtaler, risikovurderinger, koordinering, myndighedssamarbejde og støtte til at skabe en ny tilværelse efter volden.

Dine arbejdsopgaver omfatter blandt andet:

  • Åben rådgivning til borgere, som ikke er indskrevet på krisecenteret.

  • Visitationssamtaler og vurdering af indskrivningsgrundlag og sikkerhedsbehov.

  • Udarbejdelse og løbende opfølgning på risikovurderinger og relevante sikkerhedstiltag.

  • Ugentlige samtaler med de borgere, du er kontaktperson for.

  • Rådgivning og vejledning omkring blandt andet bolig, økonomi, sociale ydelser, bopæl og forældremyndighed.

  • Koordinering af borgernes sager på tværs af myndigheder og øvrige samarbejdspartnere.

  • Handleplansmøder med borgere og betalingskommuner.

  • Udarbejdelse af opholdsplaner

  • Tværfagligt samarbejde omkring både voksne og medfølgende børn.

  • Journalføring, notatpligt og øvrig relevant socialfaglig dokumentation.

Hvem søger vi?

Vi søger først og fremmest en erfaren socialrådgiver, som hviler i sin faglighed og kan arbejde selvstændigt.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er uddannet socialrådgiver

  • Har minimum 5 års relevant erhvervserfaring.

  • Har solid socialfaglig erfaring og gerne erfaring med udsatte borgere, vold i nære relationer, myndighedsarbejde, familieområdet eller lignende.

  • Er stærk både mundtligt og skriftligt.

  • Kan skabe en professionel og tillidsfuld relation til mennesker, der befinder sig i en krisesituation.

  • Kan arbejde struktureret og bevare overblikket, også når planerne pludselig ændrer sig.

  • Forstår betydningen af grundig og rettidig dokumentation.

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt, men samtidig ser tværfagligt samarbejde som en naturlig del af arbejdet.

  • Har mod på at være en aktiv del af huset og beboernes hverdag , vi er et krisecenter, ikke kun en kontorarbejdsplads.

Vi lægger vægt på faglighed og erfaring, men også på hvem du er som menneske. Vi bruger mange timer sammen, og derfor betyder humor, engagement, fleksibilitet og lysten til at bidrage til fællesskabet også noget for os.

Team og organisering

Krisecenter Guldborgsund er kendetegnet ved et tæt og tværfagligt samarbejde.

Du bliver en del af et team bestående af leder, faglig koordinator, socialrådgivere, pædagoger, psykoterapeut, psykolog, administrativ medarbejder, pedel og rengøringspersonale.

Vi hjælper hinanden på tværs af faggrupper og forventer, at alle bidrager til huset og den fælles opgave.

Arbejdstid

Rådgivernes arbejdstid er som udgangspunkt placeret i dagtimerne, typisk kl. 8.00-15.00 og enkelte dage kl. 8.00-16.00.

I denne stilling vil onsdag være den faste ugentlige lange arbejdsdag med arbejdstid frem til kl. 18.00.

Du bestemmer selv om du ønsker 30, 32 eller 37 timer ugentligt.

Derudover indgår rådgiverne i:

  • Weekendvagt hver 8. weekend, lørdag og søndag kl. 10.00-16.00.

  • Helligdagsvagter, typisk 1-2 vagter afhængigt af de pågældende helligdage.

Personalegruppen planlægger i høj grad selv fordelingen af sommerferie og helligdagsvagter. Det fungerer rigtig godt i praksis, og medarbejderne er gode til at koordinere indbyrdes og tage hensyn til både hinandens ønsker og krisecenterets behov for bemanding.

Vi tilbyder

  • En fast stilling på en arbejdsplads, hvor dit arbejde har reel betydning for mennesker i en vanskelig livssituation.

  • Et stærkt og engageret tværfagligt miljø.

  • En arbejdsplads med høje faglige ambitioner og plads til udvikling.

  • En hverdag med både selvstændighed, ansvar og mulighed for faglig sparring.

  • En organisation i udvikling, hvor der ikke er langt fra idé til handling.

  • En arbejdsplads, hvor vi prioriterer både faglighed, samarbejde, humor og et godt arbejdsmiljø.

  • Og ikke mindst: de bedste og sjoveste kollegaer – en god blanding af både mænd og kvinder.

Ansættelse

Stillingen er en fast stilling med ansættelse fra 1/11-2026

Ansøgning samt CV sendes til linda@krisecenterguldborgsund.dk

Ansøgningsfrist: 20. septmber 2026

Ansættelsessamtaler forventes afholdt: 24. septmeber 2026

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte:

Linda Møllgren
Leder, Krisecenter Guldborgsund
Telefon: 51 93 07 82 mellem kl. 11.00-14.00
Mail: linda@krisecenterguldborgsund.dk

Vi søger ikke bare en socialrådgiver, der kan løse en række opgaver. Vi søger en ny kollega, som har lyst til at være en aktiv del af vores hus, vores faglige udvikling og den forskel, vi hver eneste dag forsøger at skabe for mennesker udsat for vold i nære relationer.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

title: Postdoc in sodium-ion battery state estimation
description:
At AAU Energy, a position as Postdoc in sodium-ion battery state estimation is open for appointment from 1st of November 2026 or as soon as possible hereafter. The position is available for a period of 20 months and is based at Aalborg University’s campus in Aalborg.

You will be part of the research group Batteries, which is placed in the section for Mechatronic Systems. The position is closely connected to our activities within applied battery research, and your work will contribute to the development of new knowledge within this field.

Your work tasks
In this position you will conduct research within battery state estimation, with a particular focus on emerging sodium-ion battery technology. You will be involved in both independent and collaborative research activities in close interaction with colleagues in the group and external partners in Denmark and abroad.

You will work with the design and execution of research studies, the analysis and interpretation of data, and the dissemination of results in high-quality scientific outlets. Your daily work will typically involve a combination of independent research and collaboration in project teams, where you help develop concepts, methods and solutions that are relevant for the energy sector.

In particular, you will be involved in a research project related to development of a battery management system (BMS) tailored for sodium-ion batteries. The tasks include battery cell characterization and modelling based on laboratory tests, and development of algorithms for estimating the charge level, health, and power capability which includes robustness against different operation conditions. The position is a part of a research project and prototype battery modules will be produced by one of the partners. The tasks include testing of these prototype modules as well. Sodium-ion batteries is a relatively new technology, and they have their own electrochemical properties. One of the key questions of this research project is to obtain a better understanding of the difference between emerging sodium-ion batteries and traditional lithium-ion based batteries when it comes to the battery state estimation and management.

You will be expected to contribute to scientific publications in international peer-reviewed journals and to present your work at conferences, workshops and meetings with partners. You will collaborate with researchers across the department and, where relevant, with industrial or public stakeholders. The position may include a limited amount of teaching and supervision of students at bachelor’s and master’s level, for example in the form of project supervision or involvement in courses related to your expertise. Depending on project needs, you may also take part in preparing applications for external research funding and in supporting the development of new research directions at the department.

Your competencies
You hold a PhD degree in Electrical Engineering, Control Engineering, Electrochemistry or a closely related field or can document equivalent scientific qualifications at PhD level. Your research profile is clearly connected to battery state estimation, and you can demonstrate experience with development of battery electric equivalent circuit models and algorithms for estimating the charge, health, and power based on direct methods (e.g. open circuit voltage), model-based methods (e.g. Kalman filtering), data driven methods (e.g. machine learning or neural networks), etc. The experience could come from lithium-ion, lithium-ion capacitor, sodium-ion, or other battery technologies.

You have solid skills in Matlab/Simulink simulation tool, experimental work in laboratory environments, working with battery cyclers and equipment for electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS), preparing battery test setups, and data processing and analysis of battery test data and you are comfortable working systematically with complex technical problems. Experience with industrial collaboration and battery management systems will be an advantage, as well as documented ability to publish in international journals.

You communicate clearly in English, both orally and in writing, and you can present your work to both specialists and non-specialists. If you already speak Danish or would like to learn it, this will be an asset in everyday life at the university and in Danish society, and language courses are available locally.

You are motivated by working in an international academic environment, where you collaborate closely with colleagues, share knowledge and contribute actively to joint projects, while also managing your own tasks in a structured and responsible way. You are curious, open to feedback and able to move projects forward from idea to concrete results within agreed deadlines.

Who we are
AAU Energy is a research department at Aalborg University dedicated to the development of clean and sustainable energy systems. Our activities cover electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technologies, and we work closely with industrial partners and other academic environments to address real-world energy challenges.

The department is located in both Aalborg and Esbjerg, and this position is based at the Aalborg campus. AAU Energy employs around 250 staff members at different career stages and from a broad range of national backgrounds. This creates an international and interdisciplinary research environment with many opportunities for collaboration and knowledge sharing. English is widely used as the working language in research and teaching, which makes it straightforward for international colleagues to integrate.

We offer access to advanced laboratory and workshop facilities and an environment where you can develop your academic profile through research, teaching and collaboration with both Danish and international external partners. As a workplace we value a collegial and inclusive culture with room for professional discussion, initiative and mutual support in everyday work.

New colleagues, whether they come from elsewhere in Denmark or from abroad, can draw on the university’s support services related to relocation, housing and practical matters. Aalborg University offers general onboarding support to all new employees, as well as dedicated support for international staff through its International Staff Unit (ISU). You can read more about relocation support and services here: https://www.en.hr.aau.dk/relocation-support

Aalborg University also offers Danish language courses to support international employees in settling into both the workplace and Danish society. International employees typically can attend Danish language courses during their first years in Denmark (depending on individual eligibility and national schemes).

You can read more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dk.

Do you have any questions?
If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us.

For professional questions, please contact Erik Schaltz, Associate Professor, esc@energy.aau.dk, +45 99403302.

Qualification requirements
Appointment as postdoc requires academic qualifications at PhD level.

How to apply
Your application must include the following:

  • Application, stating reasons for applying, qualifications in relation to the position, and intentions and visions for the position
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV)
  • Diplomas (master's degree diploma and PhD diploma)
  • List of publications, with an indication of the attached publications that you wish to be taken into account in the assessment. You may attach a maximum of five publications.
  • Documentation of teaching qualifications if relevant.
  • Dissemination qualifications, including participation on committees or boards, participation in organisations etc.
  • Additional qualifications in relation to the position
  • References/recommendations

You can read more about the requirements for your application here.

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position.

Aalborg University has a policy of parallel language use. International staff are encouraged, with support from the university, to learn Danish during their employment in order to support their integration into the workplace and Danish society.

Danish language courses will be offered as part of the employment.

Further information
Read more about our recruitment process here

The appointment process at Aalborg University involves a shortlisting process. You can read more about the shortlisting and appointment process here.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Salary and terms of employment
The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities (the Appointment Order) and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities (in Danish) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities (in Danish).

Salary and terms of employment are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) (only in Danish) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities (only in Danish).

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world
Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.
