title: Senior Software Engineer, Growth - Quick Commerce (Softwareentwickler/in)
description:
Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:
Senior Software Engineer, Java (Category Management)

Stellenbeschreibung:
Company Description

As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We push hard, learn quickly and stay human along the way. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.

Job Description

We are on the lookout for a Senior Software Engineer, Java (Category Management) to join our "Quick Commerce" tribe. Contribute to the creation of our next generation platform, that works on expanding our amazing delivery to new products such as groceries, pharmaceuticals, flowers and more.

The Category Management team owns product categorisation across Delivery Hero's Global Catalog, the category tree customers navigate every time they shop. Our mission is to deliver the most intuitive and personalised browsing experience, making product discovery effortless and driven by data. We focus on categorisation accuracy and coverage: how fast, how accurately, and how autonomously our systems categorise the catalog. You are welcome if you want to work at the intersection of large-scale distributed systems, applied ML/LLMs, and real customer impact across our global storefronts.

Be part of redefining how customers experience quick commerce. You’ll help build technology that scales our non-food offerings, reaching new market segments and driving revenue growth. By innovating within our Quick Commerce Team, you’ll make Delivery Hero the go-to platform for a broad range of products, helping us grow faster and deliver more value to customers around the world.

- You will build our next generation platform to not only sell food to our hungry customers but also grocery items and many more.
- You will design and optimize our internal back office applications in a fast growing environment such as a master product database, catalog management systems, campaign management, ad-serving/ad-booking systems.
- You don’t shy away from building reliable, scalable systems with high concurrency and are always eager to learn new languages and technologies.
- Your decisions will make an impact since your ideas and efforts do matter.

Qualifications

- Java or Kotlin expert in the context of distributed systems and services.
- 4+ years of experience in Spring Boot or similar Java Frameworks.
- A rock-solid foundation in Computer Science (data structures, algorithms, software design).
- Familiar with common CI/CD tools, ideally GitHub Actions, Drone, or Spinnaker.
- Actively writing high code quality, automated testing, and following engineering best practices.
- You are a pragmatic programmer who understands what is needed to get things done in a collaborative manner.

Nice to have

- Familiar with common monitoring / alerting / logging tools such as Prometheus, Datadog, ELK stack, distributed tracing
- Building, maintaining & running a high-traffic system in a microservice environment with Kubernetes.
- Familiar with communication between microservices best practices.
- Familiar with RESTful APIs, GraphQL, gRPC and Kafka.

Ensuring you and all our Heroes are looked after, happy, and healthy is always on the menu. Because if you’re in good shape, then we’re in good shape.

- Cash. Dough. Cheddar. Whatever you call it, we’ll help you with it: Employee Share Purchase Plan, Sabbatical Bank, Public Transportation Ticket Discount, Life & Accident Insurance, Corporate Pension Plan
- The power of getting together over some food is unrivaled. Here are a few ways to help you do that. All the yum: Digital Meal Vouchers, Food Vouchers, Corporate Discounts. Courses.

- deine Persönlichkeit, die durch einen teamorientierten, pragmatischen und proaktiven Ansatz geprägt ist

- Freude an der Erarbeitung praktischer Lösungen für die Probleme unserer Mandanten in einem juristisch anspruchsvollen Umfeld
- sehr gutes juristisches Verständnis und überdurchschnittliche Examina
- hervorragende Englischkenntnisse
- dein Auge fürs Detail sowie hohe analytische und kommunikative Fähigkeiten
- angenehme und wertschätzende Kommunikation, die du sowohl gegenüber Kolleg:innen, Mitarbeitenden als auch Mandanten einzusetzen verstehst

Wir bieten dir

- spannende nationale und internationale Mandate und von Anfang an einen direkten Draht zu den Mandanten
- eine interessante und abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit in einem internationalen Team mit flachen Hierarchien
- eine langfristige berufliche Perspektive in einer führenden und sich stets weiterentwickelnden modernen Wirtschaftskanzlei
- die Förderung und Unterstützung deiner fachlichen und persönlichen Entwicklung und stets ein offenes Ohr

Osborne Clarke versteht sich als diverse Gesellschaft. Wir betrachten dies nicht nur als Floskel, sondern leben diese Einstellung jeden Tag. Wir stehen für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt und setzen uns für Integration am Arbeitsplatz ein. description:

Möchten Sie die nächste Stufe in Ihrer Karriere erreichen- Bei Brunel haben Sie die Möglichkeit, sich bei namhaften Kunden kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln - und das branchenübergreifend. ·Produktkenntnisse in Bereich des Marineschiffbaus sind von Vorteil.
·Sie haben bereits Erfahrung im Umgang mit gängigen Projektplanungstools gesammelt.

·Umfangreiche Erfahrungen und Kenntnisse im Projektmanagement sind Ihre Stärke.

·Sie zeigen die Fähigkeit, bei Abweichungen vom Soll Prozess, Ursachen zu erkennen und geeignete Maßnahmen einzufordern und zu begleiten.
·Sie überzeugen uns mit Kommunikationsstärke, Durchsetzungsvermögen auf allen Unternehmensebenen und einer hohen Einsatzbereitschaft.
·In Ihrer beruflichen Laufbahn konnten Sie im Kundenkontakt mit der deutschen und der englischen Sprache souverän punkten.
·Ihr spannendes Profil wird abgerundet mit einem guten technischen Verständnis sowie SAP -, MS Office und MS Project Kenntnissen.

Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag
Hauseigener ver.di-Tarifvertrag
30 Tage Urlaub
Gleitzeitkonto
Sozial- und Zusatzleistungen (VWL)

Remote Work

Mit dieser Ausschreibung sprechen wir vorrangig die Mitarbeitenden an, deren Verträge aufgrund von Einsparmaßnahmen auslaufen oder die von Beendigungen oder Einschränkungen betroffen sind. - Deine Expertise in der Buchhaltung, insbesondere der Kreditorenbuchhaltung, ist gepaart mit einem sicheren Umgang mit SAP R3 (FI) und/oder S4 HANA sowie den Microsoft 365 Tools
- Deine strukturierte Arbeitsweise und deine Fähigkeit, komplexe Zusammenhänge schnell zu erfassen, machen Dich zu einem wertvollen Teammitglied
- gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift runden Dein Profil ab

Benefits

im internationalen Medienumfeld

title: Senior Data Scientist - (Global Search, Consumer) (Data Scientist)
description:
Company Description

As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We enable creative minds to deliver solutions that create impact within our ecosystem. We move fast, take action and adapt. No matter where you're from or what you believe in, we build, we deliver, we lead. We are Delivery Hero.

Job Description

We are on the lookout for a Senior Data Scientist - (Global Search, Consumer) to join the Search Ranking team within our Global Search tribe. If you thrive at the intersection of cutting-edge deep learning research and high-traffic production systems — and are excited about autonomous AI-driven experimentation — this role is for you.

Our search functionality spans more than 60 countries and 35 languages, facilitating over 80 million searches daily across four continents. The ranking systems you build will directly shape what millions of customers see every time they open the app.

Your mission:

- Own the Ranking Stack End-to-End: Design, build, and productionalize deep neural ranking models — including DCN-V2, MMoE, and Two-Tower architectures — operating at high throughput and low latency in production. You will own the full lifecycle: from offline experimentation and evaluation to monitoring, and iterative improvement.
- Drive Agentic ML Research: Embrace and champion the shift from manual experimentation to prompt-driven orchestration. You will leverage LLM coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Gemini) to autonomously iterate on feature engineering and Learning to Rank (LTR) architectures. Inspired by the auto-research paradigm, you will design overnight experiment pipelines and review the outputs of hundreds of autonomous runs to identify signals quickly.
- Lead Feature Engineering and Model Architecture Innovation: Apply your deep expertise in ranking signals, feature stores, and embedding-based retrieval to push the quality of our rankers. Propose and validate new model architectures grounded in the latest research, translating academic advances into production-grade systems.
- Ensure Production Reliability: Maintain rigorous standards for model health in production. You will own monitoring for model drift, latency degradation, and feature pipeline integrity, and act quickly when signals deviate — keeping our ranking quality high for users across all markets.
- Collaborate Across Disciplines: Work as a technical partner with Backend Engineers, Data Engineers, and Product Managers to deliver end-to-end improvements. Translate complex ML trade-offs into clear narratives for non-technical stakeholders, and contribute to shaping the team's roadmap.
- Raise the Bar: Mentor junior and mid data scientists, drive best practices in experimentation rigor and code quality, and actively contribute to a culture of learning — especially around emerging agentic development workflows.

Qualifications

- Master's degree (or Bachelor's with 6+ years of work experience) in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, or a related quantitative field. 4+ years of industry experience as a Data Scientist or Machine Learning Engineer applying ML in high-traffic production environments.
- Deep Learning Ranking & LTR: Hands-on, production-proven experience implementing modern deep learning ranking architectures — DCN-V2, MMoE, Two-Tower — with strong command of multi-task learning, cross-feature interactions, and embedding optimization at scale. Solid foundation in LTR methods (pointwise, pairwise, listwise), offline evaluation metrics (NDCG, MRR), and the challenges of bridging offline metrics to online A/B outcomes.
- Agentic & AI-Assisted Development: Proficiency with LLM coding agents and agentic CLI tools (e.g., Claude Code, Gemini) as first-class tools in your development workflow — not just for boilerplate, but for autonomous experiment generation, architecture prototyping, and rapid iteration. Familiarity with the auto-research paradigm and comfort reviewing large volumes of autonomously generated experiment results.
- Technical Depth & MLOps: Expert in Python and its ML ecosystem (PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn). Comfortable with SQL (dbt), cloud environments (GCP or AWS), and big-data processing at scale (PySpark, Scala). Strong command of the full ML lifecycle — feature stores, vector databases, model versioning, A/B experimentation frameworks, and deployment to high-throughput, low-latency serving infrastructure. Hands-on experience with MLOps practices: CI/CD for ML pipelines, Metaflow, experiment tracking, model registry, and production monitoring covering drift detection, latency tracking, and data quality alerting.
- Problem-Solving & Ownership: Comfortable navigating ambiguity and translating broad business objectives into well-scoped data science projects. You hold yourself accountable for outcomes, not just outputs.
- Collaborative Spirit: Demonstrated ability to work effectively in cross-functional, globally distributed teams. Strong communication skills to articulate model behavior, experiment results, and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences

Additional Information

Ensuring you and all our Heroes are looked after, happy, and healthy is always on the menu. Because if you’re in good shape, then we’re in good shape.

- Make the most of our hybrid working model (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-9/hybrid-work-at-delivery-hero) and join the team for face-to-face connection and collaboration in our beautiful Berlin campus 2 days a week
- We offer 27 days holiday with an extra day on 2nd and 3rd year of service
- We will support you in developing yourself and your career growth opportunities: 1.000 € Educational Budget, Language Courses, Parental Support and access to the Udemy Business platform to explore a variety of online courses.
- Get moving and release those wonderful, mind-boosting endorphins: Health Checkups, Meditation & Gym.
- Cash. Dough. Cheddar. Whatever you call it, we’ll help you with it: Employee Share Purchase Plan, Sabbatical Bank, Public Transportation Ticket Discount, Life & Accident Insurance, Corporate Pension Plan
- The power of getting together over some food is unrivaled. Here are a few ways to help you do that. All the yum: Digital Meal Vouchers and Food Vouchers.
- Wondering what relocating to Berlin is like? In this article, we’ve put together10 things you should know about moving to Berlin (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-10/blogmoving-to-berlin-guide?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullet+text&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) and how Delivery Hero can support you. You can also visit our relocation hub (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/relocation-hub?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullettext&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) and check out more information about moving to Berlin.

title: Junior Commercial Coordinator (m/w/d) (Location-Coordinator)
description:
Die AXSOL GmbH entwickelt innovative Batteriespeichersysteme für unterschiedlichste Anwendungen. Mit unseren Energy Container Solutions kombinieren wir stationäre Batteriespeicher in modularen Energiecontainern mit unserem hauseigenen Energiemanagementsystem AXOS. So ermöglichen wir eine effiziente Integration erneuerbarer Energien, erhöhen die Versorgungssicherheit, senken Kosten und schaffen verlässliche Planungsgrundlagen.

Zur Unterstützung unseres Commercial-Bereichs suchen wir ein Organisationstalent, das gerne Verantwortung übernimmt und dafür sorgt, dass organisatorische und operative Themen zuverlässig umgesetzt werden. Du koordinierst Messen und Veranstaltungen, arbeitest mit externen Dienstleistern zusammen und unterstützt unser Team bei Marketingthemen sowie im Commercial-Innendienst.

Die Position bietet Dir einen vielseitigen Einstieg in den Commercial-Bereich und die Möglichkeit, Dein Verständnis für Vertrieb, Marketing und kommerzielle Unternehmensprozesse kontinuierlich auszubauen.

Aufgaben

- Organisatorische Koordination externer Dienstleister, insbesondere Marketingagentur und Rechtsberatung
- Eigenständige Organisation und Koordination von Messen, Veranstaltungen und weiteren Unternehmensauftritten
- Abstimmung von Terminen, Anforderungen, Unterlagen und offenen Punkten mit internen und externen Ansprechpartnern
- Eigenständige Nachverfolgung von Aufgaben, Terminen, Fristen und Rückmeldungen
- Organisation kleinerer operativer Marketingthemen, z. B. Visitenkarten, Unternehmenskleidung, Werbe- und Informationsmaterialien sowie interne Materialien
- Koordination von Bestellungen und Einholung von Angeboten im eigenen Aufgabenbereich
- Pflege und Organisation von Commercial- und Marketingmaterialien
- Unterstützung des Commercial-Teams im operativen Innendienst
- Vorbereitung und Zusammenstellung von Unterlagen, Präsentationen und Übersichten
- Unterstützung bei organisatorischen und administrativen Aufgaben rund um Verträge und kommerzielle Dokumente
- Pflege von Dokumentationen, Übersichten und Ablagestrukturen
- Übernahme eigener, klar abgegrenzter organisatorischer Themen und kleinerer Projekte

Weitere Aufgaben

- Mitarbeit in bereichsübergreifenden Projekten
- Mitwirkung an der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung von Prozessen und Arbeitsabläufen

title: Responsable marketing (19125) (H/F)
description:
Située à 1h de Paris, X-FAB regroupe l'ensemble des métiers allant de la production à la commercialisation de nos produits.
Nous fabriquons avec passion des puces (semiconducteurs) qui contribuent à améliorer la vie des gens, à connecter les gens et à rendre les moyens de transport plus sûrs et plus respectueux de l'environnement.
Localisation : Corbeil-Essonnes (91)

Votre rôle :
Le Responsable Marketing Produit Photonique sur Silicium (f/h) contribue au développement et au positionnement de l'offre de fonderie en photonique sur silicium de X-FAB, avec un accent particulier sur X-FAB France.
Dans ce rôle, vous combinerez analyse de marché, relations clients et collaboration transverse avec les différentes fonctions de l'entreprise afin de soutenir la croissance de l'activité et de renforcer la feuille de route technologique de la société.
Vous reporterez directement au Directeur Business & Strategy de la Business Unit Microsystems & Photonics.

Vos missions :
-    Contribuer à l'élaboration et à la mise en œuvre des stratégies de X-FAB visant à accroître le chiffre d'affaires et la rentabilité dans le domaine de la photonique sur silicium.
-    Identifier et développer de nouvelles opportunités commerciales en établissant des relations avec les clients, les décideurs et les acteurs clés du secteur à l'échelle internationale.
-    Piloter les projets commerciaux liés aux opportunités de photonique sur silicium de grande envergure et spécifiques aux clients, notamment en assurant la coordination du périmètre, des priorités et l'alignement des parties prenantes.
-    Réaliser des études de marché, des analyses concurrentielles et des activités de recueil des retours clients afin de soutenir la prise de décision.
-    Traduire les besoins du marché en contributions à la définition de la feuille de route technologique et produit, en collaboration avec les équipes d'ingénierie.
-    Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Marketing, Ventes et Ingénierie d'Applications Terrain (Field Application Engineering) afin d'accompagner les clients.
-    Soutenir les activités de développement des comptes stratégiques sur les marchés ciblés de la photonique sur silicium.
-    Contribuer aux initiatives marketing en collaboration avec l'équipe Marketing Communications (présentations, webinaires, supports promotionnels, etc.).
-    Représenter X-FAB lors de conférences internationales, salons professionnels et événements du secteur.


Votre profil :
-    Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme d'ingénieur ou d'un master avec une spécialisation en électronique, physique, microélectronique ou dans un domaine connexe.
-    Vous justifiez de plusieurs années d'expérience en développement commercial, marketing produit ou dans une fonction en contact direct avec les clients au sein d'un environnement technologique de pointe.
-    Vous possédez des connaissances ou un intérêt marqué pour la photonique, les semi-conducteurs ou des technologies associées. Une expérience en photonique sur silicium constitue un atout, sans être indispensable.
-    Vous avez une bonne compréhension des stratégies de mise sur le marché (go-to-market) dans des environnements techniques.
-    Vous disposez d'une expérience dans la gestion de la relation client, des parties prenantes et des négociations.
-    Vous faites preuve de solides capacités d'analyse et savez transformer des sujets techniques en opportunités commerciales.
-    Vous démontrez d'excellentes compétences en communication et en présentation, en français comme en anglais.
-    Vous adoptez une approche de travail proactive et structurée, avec une forte capacité à collaborer efficacement au sein d'équipes internationales et pluridisciplinaires.
-    Vous êtes disponible pour effectuer des déplacements professionnels à l'international.

title: Erzieher/in (m/w/d) für den Krippenbereich Kunst-Kita (Erzieher/in)
description:
Lorenzini Kunst-Kita – Kreativ von Anfang an!

Seit 2008 schaffen wir in Hamburg mit unseren mittlerweile fünf Kitas im Krippen- und Elementarbereich Räume, in denen Kinder selbst bestimmt lernen, ihrem Forscherdrang nachgehen und ihre Neugier stillen können. Unser Raum-in-Raum-Konzept bildet verschiedene Funktionsbereiche mit Spiel- und Arbeitsmaterialien, die allen Kindern klare Spielanreize bieten und deren Phantasie anregen. Wir orientieren uns an der Reggio-Pädagogik und integrieren ausgewählte Elemente der Montessori-Pädagogik. Bei uns steht die Kunst- und Kreativitätsförderung im Mittelpunkt, denn wir sind überzeugt, dass dies der Schlüssel zu einer erfolgreichen frühkindlichen Bildung und Betreuung ist.

Als Erzieher bist du bei uns mehr als nur eine Betreuungsperson. Du begleitest die Kinder, wenn sie ihre Welt erforschen und entdecken, sich frei entfalten und sich auch einmal bei uns einkuscheln. Bei uns arbeitest du mit professioneller Nähe, anstatt dich hinter einer gut gemeinten Distanz zu verstecken.

Für unsere Kita "Frieda" in der Friedensallee in Hamburg Ottensen (Nähe S-Bahnhof Bahrenfeld), suchen wir engagierte und kreative

Erzieher/in (m/w/d) für den Krippenbereich

in Voll- oder Teilzeit (ab 30 Stunden/Woche)

Unsere Frieda verfügt über 90 Krippen- und Elementarplätzen sowie einer angeschlossenen Lernwerkstatt. In den lichtdurchfluteten und transparent gestalteten Räumen, leben wir das Raum-in-Raum Konzept nach dem Ansatz der Reggio-Pädagogik und dem Raum als „Dritter Erzieher“.

In den Krippenräumen laden eine Kinderwohnung, ein Atelier, der Forscherbereich, eine Leseecke und ein großzügiger Rollenspielbereich zum Spielen ein. Eine Hochebene ermöglicht es, das Geschehen aus einer anderen Perspektive wahrzunehmen. Direkt vor unserem Haus lädt unser Außengelände zum Spielen ein. Die Kinder können im Sommer an der Wasserpumpe arbeiten und jede Menge Matsch produzieren, in einer der Sandkisten bauen oder im Schwedenhaus mit dem kleinen Minigarten spielen.

Das bringst du mit:

- Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als staatlich anerkannter Erzieher, sozialpädagogischer Assistent, Kinderpfleger, Heilerzieher oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
- Begeisterung für die Arbeit mit Kindern und Interesse an der Reggio-Pädagogik
- Kreativität und Freude an der Umsetzung künstlerischer Projekte
- Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Empathie im Umgang mit Kindern und Eltern
- Offenheit für neue pädagogische Ansätze und Bereitschaft zur Weiterentwicklung

Das bieten wir dir:

- Leistungsgerechte Vergütung: dein Gehalt richtet sich transparent nach Deiner Qualifikation und ist vergleichbar zum TVöD SuE. Zudem bekommst du einen Zuschuss zum Deutschland-Ticket
- Viel Erholung: 30 Tage Urlaub plus fünf Tage Freistellung bedeuten für dich sieben Wochen Freizeit im Jahr.
- Planbare Arbeitszeiten: für Montag bis Freitag bekommst du rechtzeitig eine verlässliche Dienstplanung von uns, das Wochenende und die Feiertage gehören dir
- Pädagogische Ausrichtung: unsere offene Arbeit, angelehnt an die Reggio-Pädagogik mit ausgewählten Elementen der Montessori-Pädagogik, lässt dich unsere pädagogische Haltung mit Respekt, Regeln und Wertschätzung auf Augenhöhe erleben
- Kreativer Arbeitsbereich: du bringst deine künstlerischen Fähigkeiten ein und hilfst den Kindern, ihre kreative Seite zu entdecken und zu entfalten
- Wertschätzung der Raumgestaltung: du gestaltest und pflegst die Funktionsbereiche mit und sorgst so dafür, dass der Raum als dritter Erzieher eine anregende Lernumgebung bietet
- Wertiges Spiel- und Arbeitsmaterial: du hast Zugang zu einer Vielzahl von Materialien und Techniken, um den Kindern ein breites Spektrum an kreativen Möglichkeiten zu bieten und vielfältige pädagogische Ansätze umzusetzen
- Teamarbeit: wir teilen dieselbe Leidenschaft für Kunst und Pädagogik, tauschen uns in unserer wöchentlichen Teamzeit über Ideen für die Entwicklung unserer Arbeit aus und lernen durch regelmäßige Feedbackgespräche
- Niedriger Erzieher-Kind-Schlüssel: unser offenes Raum-in-Raum-Konzept, in dem sich jeweils Krippen- und Elementarkinder die Räume teilen, ergibt einen besseren Erzieher-Kind-Schlüssel, so dass du dich intensiver um die Bedürfnisse der Kinder kümmern kannst
- Persönliche und berufliche Entwicklung: vielfältige Fort- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten sowie jährlich stattfindende Studien- und Fachtage mit den Lorenzini-Kollegen aus den verschiedenen Einrichtungen sorgen für fachlichen Austausch und vermitteln neue pädagogische Ansätze. Berufseinsteigern bieten wir in den ersten Jahren eine enge Begleitung im Team

Schau dir auch gerne unser Youtube-Video an, wenn du mehr über die Arbeit bei uns erfahren möchtest: https://youtu.be/Eib75FXd1xA (https://youtu.be/Eib75FXd1xA)

Du suchst eine Tätigkeit, in die du dich einerseits voll einbringen, dich aber auch auf feste und sichere Abläufe verlassen kannst? Du hast keine Lust mehr auf nur „satt, sicher, sauber“, sondern suchst eine Kita mit flachen Hierarchien, die Raum für eigene Ideen lässt, dir aber auch eine Struktur bietet, die auf vielen Jahren Erfahrung im frühkindlichen Bildungsbereich basiert? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung per Mail an: lorenz@kunst-kita.de

Oder bewirb dich direkt über unsere Website: www.kunst-kita.de

title: Postdoctoral researcher in Microbial Biophysics (f/m/d) (Biophysiker/in)
description:
A focus of our research are Engineered Living Materials (ELMs), an emergent class of materials from the combination of inert materials and living organism, with huge potential for sustainable innovation in different technological fields. Across the institute, materials scientists, synthetic biologists and biophysicists cooperate to understand living and inert matter, and to realize new materials with unprecedented functions from a synergistic interfacing.

We are strongly linked to collaborative initiatives in the ELM field including the Leibniz ScienceCampus LifeMat, Living Therapeutic Materials, the Priority Program SPP2451 “Living Materials with Adaptive Functions”, and the MaterialVital Hub.

As part of our ELM research community, we are seeking a

Postdoctoral Researcher with expertise in Microbial Biophysics (f/m/d)

with interest in the fundamental understanding of microbial communities within synthetic microenvironments. The candidate will be part of an interdisciplinary research team within the Department Dynamic Biomaterials at INM.

Your roles:

- Experimental research to understand microbial behaviour in confined spaces (synthetic hydrogels) and dynamic environments using imaging, microfluidics and molecular biology methods.
- Scientific cooperation with researchers in materials science and synthetic biology at INM, and with external partners in bioanalytics/bioinformatics within running funded projects.
- Compilation and presentation of research results in the form of progress reports and presentations at project meetings and scientific conferences.
- Communication of research results within the scientific community at conferences and scientific events, and publication in scientific journals.
- Co-supervision of students and doctoral researchers.
- Support and promote the digitalization of ELM research in collaboration with dedicated experts in the group.

Your profile:

- PhD degree in biophysics/cell biology or related discipline.
- Experience during your PhD or previous postdoctoral stay as experimental researcher in the field of microbial biophysics.
- Interest in collaborative and interdisciplinary research challenges.
- Self-driven and hands-on personality. Organization and prioritization skills.
- Very good communication skills in English.

We offer:

- Work in an emergent research topic, with multiple opportunities to develop a competitive research profile.
- An interdisciplinary research environment with complementary expertise and ready to share knowledge and support your work.
- State-of-the-art infrastructure, including access to Core Facilities run by experts.
- Access to a broad international network with vibrant scientific collaborators and exciting cooperation projects.
- A highly professional and supportive working environment with an open and international culture.
- A well-structured on-boarding process and clear responsibilities.
- Transparent opportunities for career development.
- Flexible working hours and mobile working opportunity.
- A family-friendly working place.
- A EG 13 TV-L position (full time). A part time position is also possible.

The position is initially for 2 years.

Interested?

We look forward to your application! Please upload your CV and motivation letter, by October 15th, 2026 via the online application system. For further information on this position, please contact INM Scientific Director and Head of the Research Department Dynamic Biomaterials Prof. Dr. Aránzazu del Campo (aranzazu.delcampo@leibniz-inm.de ).

The INM practices an open and appreciative corporate culture in which the existing diversity is promoted and lived. The institute is an equal opportunity employer with a certified family-friendly policy, and it provides offers for a better work-life balance, flextime, and mobile working. We promote professional opportunities for women and strongly encourage them to apply. Full time jobs can be generally divided. People with disabilities are expressly encouraged to apply and will be given priority if equally qualified.

Als freier Träger der Kinder- und Jugendhilfe ist der ASB an 31 Grundschulen und vier weiterführenden Schulen im Regionalverband Saarbrücken für die Schulsozialarbeit zuständig.

Zur Vertretung während Mutterschutzfrist und Elternzeit suchen wir ab sofort mehrere Schulsozialarbeiter/Schulsozialarbeiterinnen (m/w/d) in Voll- oder Teilzeit.

Diese Vorteile erwarten Sie:

•    attraktive Vergütung gem. ASB-Tarifvertrag bis Entgeltgruppe S 12 TVöD SuE, monatliche SuE-Zulage sowie eine Jahressonderzahlung,

•    30 Tage Jahresurlaub, zusätzlich arbeitsfrei am 24.12 und 31.12 d. Jahres, Sonderurlaubstage zu besonderen Anlässen,

•    regelmäßige Teamgespräche mit fachlichem Austausch sowie Unterstützung für alle Teammitglieder,

•    die Chance, eine eigene berufliche Identität zu finden und sich mit den eigenen Stärken einzubringen,

•    regelmäßige Fortbildung, u. a. durch das ASB-Bildungswerk in Köln

Das sollten Sie mitbringen:

•    abgeschlossenes Studium als Sozialarbeiter/Sozialarbeiterin bzw. Sozialpädagoge/Sozialpädagogin oder

•    abgeschlossenes Studium als Erziehungswissenschaftler/Erziehungswissenschaftlerin in Verbindung mit einer geeigneten Zusatzqualifikation im Bereich des SGB VIII oder

•    Abschluss als staatlich anerkannter Erzieher/staatlich anerkannte Erzieherin in Verbindung mit einer mehrjährigen Berufserfahrung und Zusatzqualifikation im Bereich des SGB VIII

•    strukturierte und selbständige Arbeitsweise

•    hohe Motivation und Zuverlässigkeit

•    Teamfähigkeit

•    Berufserfahrung von Vorteil

title: Director, Sales Operations DACH (Sales-Manager/in)
description:
The Director, Sales Operations — DACH is a senior leadership role responsible for the operational effectiveness, productivity, and go-to-market efficiency of Mitel's sales organization across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland. The role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution, partnering directly with DACH Sales Leadership to drive performance through world-class processes, data-driven insight, and operational rigor.

Reporting to the Group Director, Sales Operations International, the Director will lead a dedicated DACH Sales Operations team and work in close partnership with cross-functional stakeholders across Finance, HR, Marketing, IT, and the global Revenue Operations function. This is a high-visibility role with direct impact on revenue, growth, and organizational effectiveness across one of Mitel's most strategically important regions.

Job Responsibilities

1. Sales Planning, Forecasting & Quota Management

- Lead sales forecasting, planning, and budgeting processes across the DACH region, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and strategic alignment with global Revenue Operations standards
- Design and own the equitable allocation of sales quotas across all DACH channels and resources, ensuring every team member is set up to succeed and all objectives are assigned on time
- Proactively monitor planning quality and process consistency; coordinate planning activities with Finance, HR, and global Sales Operations as required
- Attend and actively contribute to ELT forecast reviews, bi-weekly regional forecast reviews, and Close the Gap sessions, providing data-driven analysis and actionable recommendations
- Responsible for theatre communications within the DACH sales organisation on process, programmes, and initiatives

2. Go-to-Market Coverage & Territory Optimisation

- Design and optimise go-to-market coverage models across the DACH region, ensuring the right sales resources are deployed against the highest-value market opportunities
- Lead account segmentation initiatives — analysing firmographic, revenue, and growth-potential data to classify accounts and align them to the most effective sales motions
- Own sales representative and channel assignment frameworks, balancing workload, market potential, and specialisation to maximise revenue per head and overall regional ROI
- Partner with Sales Leadership and Finance to model territory design scenarios, simulate revenue impact, and make data-driven recommendations on coverage changes
- Continuously monitor coverage efficiency metrics including whitespace analysis, account penetration rates, and capacity utilisation to identify and act on growth opportunities

3. Channel Integrity & Direct/Partner Segregation

- Define, document, and enforce clear rules of engagement between Mitel's direct sales force and channel partners, ensuring unambiguous account ownership and minimising conflict across DACH
- Own and maintain the account segmentation framework that determines which accounts are served direct versus through channel, based on criteria including account size, strategic value, geography, and partner capability
- Establish and govern escalation and arbitration processes for channel conflict, acting as the neutral arbiter when direct and partner routes overlap or compete for the same opportunity
- Work with Sales Leadership and Channel Management to implement systematic account tagging and CRM controls that enforce segregation policies and provide full visibility into coverage boundaries
- Conduct regular audits of direct and partner account assignments to detect and resolve boundary violations, ensuring compliance with Mitel's channel programme terms
- Partner with Legal, Finance, and Channel Programme teams to ensure compensation and incentive structures reinforce the segregation between direct and indirect sales motions

4. Process Excellence & Continuous Improvement

- Proactively identify and eliminate bottlenecks in the sales process, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and operational rigour across DACH
- Lead process definition and documentation for DACH Sales Operations, including approval policies, PreSales workflows, and Service processes — developing Business Requirement Documents (BRDs) and ensuring cross-functional alignment
- Facilitate cross-departmental workshops to define, align, and continuously improve Sales Operations processes in collaboration with Finance, Legal, HR, and IT
- Working with Sales Leaders and Marketing, implement internal sales SPIFFs and Partner Rewards programmes, managing the delivery tools
- Own and deliver process training programmes for Sales, PreSales, and Sales Management teams across DACH — preparing materials, conducting sessions, and monitoring adoption

5. Technology, Reporting & Business Intelligence

- Own the deployment and optimisation of enabling technologies including CRM across the DACH region — ensuring data integrity, compliance with global standards, and maximum ROI from Mitel's technology investments
- Monitor the accuracy and efficient distribution of sales reports and intelligence essential to the DACH sales organisation; recommend revisions to existing reports or develop new reporting tools as needed
- Build and maintain a suite of dashboards and reports that give DACH Sales Leadership the intelligence needed to make fast, well-informed decisions
- Participate in DACH Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) calls, providing Sales data and CRM insights to inform supply chain and inventory planning
- Coordinate CRM data and process alignment with the DACH Marketing team to support campaign execution, pipeline generation, and lead management

6. Deal Desk Oversight & Bid Approval Management

- Provide leadership and strategic oversight of the DACH Sales Deal Desk — ensuring accurate Named Account checks, partner certification verification, competitive analysis, and deal matrix generation for the indirect channel pipeline
- Govern the Bid Approval Management process for the DACH region, overseeing Executive Deal Reviews (Level 1), coordinating approvals in Salesforce, and maintaining thorough documentation and filing of all bid decisions
- Define and continuously refine Deal Desk processes and rules of engagement, managing escalations and ensuring cooperation between direct sales, channel teams, and deal desk resources
- Conduct Named Account list reviews on a regular basis, ensuring accurate maintenance and alignment with agreed direct/indirect coverage boundaries

7. Sales Incentive Compensation

- Provide input to senior leadership in the development and administration of sales incentive compensation programmes for the DACH region
- Working with Finance, HR, and the global Revenue Operations team, provide assistance with sales incentive compensation administration — including arbitration and clarification of compensation policy application
- Ensure compensation and incentive structures are aligned to reinforce go-to-market strategy and channel segregation objectives

8. Governance, Management Support & Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Support the DACH leadership team in Risk Control Board activities, audit processes, and governance obligations — acting as the Sales Operations representative in regional management forums
- Act as a key liaison between DACH Sales management and global Revenue Operations/Sales Operations leadership, ensuring regional priorities are well represented and global programmes are effectively localised
- Partner with the Service organisation on sales campaign coordination and deliver ad-hoc CRM-based sales reports to support Service planning activities
- Direct and support the consistent implementation of company initiatives across the DACH sales organisation
- Build peer support and strong internal relationships with key management personnel across Finance, Marketing, HR, Legal, and IT

Qualifications & Experience

- Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution, or equivalent professional experience (5+ years in B2B sales, sales operations, or sales management)
- Proven track record leading analytically complex Sales Operations or Revenue Operations initiatives with demonstrable business impact
- Deep expertise in CRM platforms (Salesforce preferred), sales analytics, and operational tooling
- Strong experience in quota design, territory modelling, and go-to-market coverage optimisation
- Experience managing or overseeing formal bid and deal approval processes in an enterprise B2B environment
- Demonstrated ability to manage channel partner relationships and enforce rules of engagement in a direct/indirect sales model
- Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills — able to influence and present confidently at all organisational levels
- Deep understanding of the DACH business landscape, commercial culture, and regulatory environment
- Fluency in German and English (written and spoken) — additional language skills in French or Italian are a plus

title: Senior Software Engineer, Growth - Quick Commerce (Softwareentwickler/in)
description:

Senior Software Engineer, Java (Category Management)

Stellenbeschreibung:
Company Description

As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We push hard, learn quickly and stay human along the way. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.

Job Description

We are on the lookout for a Senior Software Engineer, Java (Category Management) to join our "Quick Commerce" tribe. Contribute to the creation of our next generation platform, that works on expanding our amazing delivery to new products such as groceries, pharmaceuticals, flowers and more.

The Category Management team owns product categorisation across Delivery Hero's Global Catalog, the category tree customers navigate every time they shop. Our mission is to deliver the most intuitive and personalised browsing experience, making product discovery effortless and driven by data. We focus on categorisation accuracy and coverage: how fast, how accurately, and how autonomously our systems categorise the catalog. You are welcome if you want to work at the intersection of large-scale distributed systems, applied ML/LLMs, and real customer impact across our global storefronts.

Be part of redefining how customers experience quick commerce. You’ll help build technology that scales our non-food offerings, reaching new market segments and driving revenue growth. By innovating within our Quick Commerce Team, you’ll make Delivery Hero the go-to platform for a broad range of products, helping us grow faster and deliver more value to customers around the world.

- You will build our next generation platform to not only sell food to our hungry customers but also grocery items and many more.
- You will design and optimize our internal back office applications in a fast growing environment such as a master product database, catalog management systems, campaign management, ad-serving/ad-booking systems.
- You don’t shy away from building reliable, scalable systems with high concurrency and are always eager to learn new languages and technologies.
- Your decisions will make an impact since your ideas and efforts do matter.

Qualifications

- Java or Kotlin expert in the context of distributed systems and services.
- 4+ years of experience in Spring Boot or similar Java Frameworks.
- A rock-solid foundation in Computer Science (data structures, algorithms, software design).
- Familiar with common CI/CD tools, ideally GitHub Actions, Drone, or Spinnaker.
- Actively writing high code quality, automated testing, and following engineering best practices.
- You are a pragmatic programmer who understands what is needed to get things done in a collaborative manner.

Nice to have

- Familiar with common monitoring / alerting / logging tools such as Prometheus, Datadog, ELK stack, distributed tracing
- Building, maintaining & running a high-traffic system in a microservice environment with Kubernetes.
- Familiar with communication between microservices best practices.
- Familiar with RESTful APIs, GraphQL, gRPC and Kafka.

title: Servicemitarbeiter Restaurant & Veranstaltungen (m/w/d) (Fachkraft - Gastronomie (Restaurantservice))
description:
Wir suchen Dich!

**Gastgeber aus Leidenschaft? Dann komm zu uns ins Team! **

Im Best Western Plus Hotel Steinsgarten in Gießen ist kein Tag wie der andere. Beim Abendessen im Restaurant, bei Tagungen, Firmenfeiern, Hochzeiten oder anderen Veranstaltungen – wir möchten, dass sich unsere Gäste bei uns rundum wohlfühlen.

Dafür suchen wir dich als Servicemitarbeiter im Restaurant & Veranstaltungsbereich (m/w/d).

Das erwartet dich bei uns

Du bist mittendrin, wenn bei uns etwas los ist. Du betreust unsere Gäste im Restaurant und wirkst gleichzeitig bei unseren unterschiedlichen Veranstaltungen mit. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit deinen Kollegen aus Service, Küche und Veranstaltungsbereich zusammen.

Zu deinen Aufgaben gehören unter anderem

die Betreuung und Beratung unserer Gäste, der Getränke- und Speiseservice sowie die Vor- und Nachbereitung des Restaurants. Bei Tagungen, Feiern und Veranstaltungen unterstützt du beim Aufbau, sorgst während der Veranstaltung für einen reibungslosen Service und hast auch beim Abbau alles im Blick.

Das bringst du mit

Idealerweise hast du bereits Erfahrung im Service, in der Gastronomie oder Hotellerie gesammelt. Viel wichtiger ist uns aber, dass du gerne Gastgeber bist, offen auf Menschen zugehst und auch dann den Überblick behältst, wenn mehrere Dinge gleichzeitig passieren.

Du arbeitest zuverlässig und selbstständig, bist ein echter Teamplayer und hast kein Problem damit, auch abends, am Wochenende oder an Feiertagen zu arbeiten – denn genau dann finden viele unserer schönsten Veranstaltungen statt.

Ein gepflegtes Auftreten, gute Umgangsformen und gute Deutschkenntnisse setzen wir voraus.

Das bieten wir dir

Bei uns erwartet dich ein abwechslungsreicher Arbeitsplatz, an dem Restaurantservice und Veranstaltungen zusammenkommen. Du wirst Teil eines Teams, das gemeinsam anpackt, sich gegenseitig unterstützt und dabei auch den Spaß an der Arbeit nicht vergisst.

Du bekommst eine strukturierte Einarbeitung, abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben und die Möglichkeit, dich aktiv einzubringen und Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

- Einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag

- eine betriebliche Krankenversicherung nach bestandener Probezeit

title: Senior SAP Consultant (m/f/d) (Anwendungsberater/in)
employer: Heraeus Consulting & IT Solutions GmbH, HRdirekt
description:
The following challenges await you:

- Analyze business requirements and design solutions using SAP standard functionality as well as highly specialized custom modules.
- Configure SAP (customizing) with a focus on Financial Accounting (FI) and/or Production Planning (PP) and ensure stable system operations.
- Enhance and support a complex, proprietary SAP solution for precious materials processes.
- Implement change requests, perform root-cause analysis, and provide 2nd and 3rd level support.
- Support SAP projects such as system upgrades, rollouts, and release updates of varying size and complexity.
- Create functional specifications and coordinate technical implementation with development teams.
- Work closely with business stakeholders, SAP experts, and external service providers.
- Prepare documentation and support user training activities.

Your profile:

- Several years of hands-on experience in SAP FI and/or SAP PP (experience in other SAP modules is also welcome)
- Strong customizing expertise and solid understanding of end-to-end SAP process flows
- Experience working in complex, highly customized SAP environments
- Experience with SAP project work such as rollouts, upgrades, or transformations (e.g. S/4HANA is a plus)
- Basic understanding of ABAP and technical concepts to efficiently collaborate with development teams
- Analytical, structured, and solution-oriented mindset with excellent communication skills in English; proficiency in German is an advantage
- Strong team player with the ability to collaborate effectively with business stakeholders, IT colleagues, and external partners

What we offer:

- Attractive compensation - strong base salary combined with additional benefits.
- Additional financial benefits - support for private pension plans, life-phase accounts for paid leave (e.g. sabbaticals, early retirement), public transport subsidies, discounts in many (online) shops.
- Modern organisation of working time - possibility of mobile working (by agreement), focus on results-oriented work.
- Health and well-being - company medical service with comprehensive check-ups, sports facilities, social counselling and company canteen with freshly prepared meals every day.
- Sustainability and social commitment - sustainability as part of our corporate strategy and targeted support for education, family and science initiatives through our own foundations.

title: Swedish Speaking Automotive Warranty Assistant (Opel/Vauxhall)
description:
Swedish Speaking Automotive Warranty Assistant (Opel/Vauxhall)
Location: Budaörs, Budapest, Hungary

Concentrix, a global leader in Customer Service, work in partnership with the prestigious Opel/Vauxhall brand across Europe. We are currently recruiting for Warranty Assistants to join our team in Budaörs, Hungary. Located in state of the art facilities, our team of multilingual experts support a range of languages and assist the Opel/Vauxhall dealer network with the diagnosis and repair of vehicles.

What you can expect day to day:
. Handle warranty claims via phone and email.
. Fully investigating the request using Opel/Vauxhall systems, protocol and procedures.
. Escalating requests that cannot be resolved to other team members, and team leaders located both in the UK and Germany.
. Delivering service excellence by efficiently problem-solving and reacting in a professional, polite and clear manner.
. Accurately logging all Dealer contacts and following up on cases using Opel/Vauxhall database systems.
. Attending team and other meetings for review of issues, assignments, regular discussion.

What we're looking for:
. Automotive knowledge and experience preferred, gained either in a dealership, preferably Opel/Vauxhall, or with an OEM or OEM supplier business.
. Fluency in English & Swedish.
. Previous experience of handling warranty claims preferred.
. Excellent interpersonal skills, able to build constructive & effective relationships, using appropriate rapport,     diplomacy and tact.
. Ability to resolve queries to a high level remotely by telephone/email.
. Opel/Vauxhall product experience preferable.
. Good computer literacy - competent in the main Microsoft Office packages.
. Able to write clearly and succinctly in a variety of communication settings and styles.
. Time management skills, able to use time effectively and efficiently.
. Customer focus, dedicated to meeting the expectations and requirements of internal & external customers.

What can we offer you?
. Bright, modern, exciting place to work with excellent staff facilities
. Multicultural, multilingual environment.
. Excellent relocation package.
. Annual Reward & Recognition Ceremony.
. Professional development opportunities.

Relocating to Budaörs?

If you are relocating we'll help with travel costs, accommodation on arrival and salary advances to help get you settled.

Budaörs is a small city of around 30,000 people, situated at the southern edge of the Buda Hills less than 10km from Budapest. The city offers contemporary architecture, the picturesque old town, breath-taking natural surroundings and historic monuments. You can reach Budapest in a matter of minutes via road or public transport.

title: Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) (Arbeitsplanungsingenieur/in)
description:
Our Operations Team of OSI Food Solutions searches a Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) in either Toledo, Spain/ Bábolna, Hungary or Ostróda, Poland.

What your job includes

- Coordinating and analyzing the overall EU volume flow for assigned areas, ensuring smooth planning and alignment across sites
- Managing end-to-end volume planning, including demand adjustments, allocation, promotional volumes, and volume transfers between EU plants
- Working with planning tools (Excel, SAP, SAP IBP), preparing scenarios, monitoring deviations and supporting continuous improvement
- Collaborating closely with local EU sites, sales, supply chain, finance, and logistics partners to maintain accurate and efficient planning processes
- Supporting stock management, analyzing demand trends, production and delivery performance and contributing to corrective actions
- Preparing reports on planning adherence, stock trends and demand evolution
- Participating in planning projects and supporting the annual budget allocation process
- Engaging in SAP / SAP IBP implementation, helping shape systems and processes

What we expect from you

- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Data Analysis, or a similar field
- Experience in a complex supply chain manufacturing environment and in a coordination role involving planning, stock management or forecasting
- Analytical mindset with confidence in building and maintaining data analysis structures
- Autonomy in decision-making
- Strong communication and presentation skills
- Proactive approach to process improvements and openness to change
- Experience with SAP is a significant advantage
- Very good English (written and verbal); additional local language skills are beneficial

What we offer you

We are a company with flat hierarchies, value-based corporate culture and a pronounced customer orientation in a special market. We know that the commitment of our employees is the basis of our success. We therefore support you by quickly giving you responsibility and developing you according to your talents.

Other benefits depending on the location

description:
RÓLUNK

A LEDER & SCHUH AG két értékesítési márkájával, a HUMANIC-kal és a SHOE4YOU-val Európa egyik legnagyobb cipőkereskedője. A vállalat kilenc országban (AT, DE, CZ, SK, HU, HU, SI, HR, RO, BG) mintegy 200 telephelyen mintegy 2000 embert foglalkoztat. A vállalat központja a stájer fővárosban, Grazban található. Nagy hangsúlyt fektetünk a hosszú távú munkakapcsolatok kiépítésére és a vállalaton belüli karrierépítésre.

title: Head Operational Excellence Europe (m/f/d) (Operations Manager/in)
description:
To further strengthen our Operations & Supply Chain organization, we are looking for an experienced Head of Operational Excellence at Group level.

This high-impact role, reporting directly to the COO, offers a unique opportunity to design, build, and implement the Operational Excellence system from the start. You will operate within an international environment with multiple manufacturing sites.

In this initial phase, you will take the lead in developing and rolling out the foundation of our Operational Excellence framework, driving sustainable operational improvements throughout the organization.

Your mission

- In the first phase, your key responsibility will be to: - Design and establish the Group-wide Operational Excellence Production System
- Build the standards, tools and governance needed for sustainable implementation
- Create and roll out structured processes across Production, Logistics and Quality
- Set up performance management (KPI cascade, visual management, gap analysis)
- Develop and initiate the first wave of improvement projects and cost optimization pipeline
- Following this setup phase, you will: - Drive year-on-year efficiency improvements
- Scale and embed Lean & Six Sigma methodologies across all sites
- Act as a change leader, embedding mindset, behavior and capabilities

Your profile

- Master’s degree in engineering with strong analytical and statistical skills
- At least 3 years of leadership experience in a complex operations/manufacturing environment
- Strong track record in building and implementing Operational Excellence frameworks from the ground up
- Deep expertise in Lean / Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt preferred)
- Structured, hands-on and capable of turning concepts into execution
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
- Willingness to travel across Europe (25–50%)
- Fluent in English and preferably German

Benefits

- **Work-life balance:** We offer flexible working hours in a hybrid work environment
- **Time off & flexibility:** With 30 days of vacation per year and flexible scheduling
- **Quick decision-making & autonomy:** You’ll benefit from quick decision-making and plenty of freedom to pursue your own ideas and creative solutions
- **Motivated team & international environment:** Work in a dedicated team with colleagues from different countries and cultures
- Individual management coaching: We support your personal and professional development through individual coaching
- **Exciting tasks:** Look forward to varied responsibilities in a sustainable and innovative company
- **Comprehensive benefits:** Enjoy advantages such as capital-forming benefits, TicketPlus, Hansefit and exclusive discounts

Your next step - get in touch!

We welcome your application, including details of your salary expectations and your earliest possible start date. For initial contact, please reach out to Roman Heizmann, Recruiting Manager.

title: Supply Chain Planning: Project Management Specialist (m/f/d) (Demand Planner)
description:
About OSI

OSI Europe is a leading company in the food industry, specializing in the production of high-quality food products. With several production sites in Europe and a global distribution network, we offer first-class solutions for customers worldwide.

Our European Headquarter in Gersthofen is looking for a** Project Management Specialist (m/f/d). **Possible other locations: Bábolna, Toledo, Ostróda, Enns, Günzburg, Duisburg.

- Support the Digitalization of our Planning Team: SOP process, periodical KPI sharing, stock levels

title: Swedish Speaking Automotive Warranty Assistant (Opel/Vauxhall)
description:
Swedish Speaking Automotive Warranty Assistant (Opel/Vauxhall)
Location: Budaörs, Budapest, Hungary

Concentrix, a global leader in Customer Service, work in partnership with the prestigious Opel/Vauxhall brand across Europe. We are currently recruiting for Warranty Assistants to join our team in Budaörs, Hungary. Located in state of the art facilities, our team of multilingual experts support a range of languages and assist the Opel/Vauxhall dealer network with the diagnosis and repair of vehicles.

What you can expect day to day:
. Handle warranty claims via phone and email.
. Fully investigating the request using Opel/Vauxhall systems, protocol and procedures.
. Escalating requests that cannot be resolved to other team members, and team leaders located both in the UK and Germany.
. Delivering service excellence by efficiently problem-solving and reacting in a professional, polite and clear manner.
. Accurately logging all Dealer contacts and following up on cases using Opel/Vauxhall database systems.
. Attending team and other meetings for review of issues, assignments, regular discussion.

What we're looking for:
. Automotive knowledge and experience preferred, gained either in a dealership, preferably Opel/Vauxhall, or with an OEM or OEM supplier business.
. Fluency in English & Swedish.
. Previous experience of handling warranty claims preferred.
. Excellent interpersonal skills, able to build constructive & effective relationships, using appropriate rapport,     diplomacy and tact.
. Ability to resolve queries to a high level remotely by telephone/email.
. Opel/Vauxhall product experience preferable.
. Good computer literacy - competent in the main Microsoft Office packages.
. Able to write clearly and succinctly in a variety of communication settings and styles.
. Time management skills, able to use time effectively and efficiently.
. Customer focus, dedicated to meeting the expectations and requirements of internal & external customers.

What can we offer you?
. Bright, modern, exciting place to work with excellent staff facilities
. Multicultural, multilingual environment.
. Excellent relocation package.
. Annual Reward & Recognition Ceremony.
. Professional development opportunities.

Relocating to Budaörs?

If you are relocating we'll help with travel costs, accommodation on arrival and salary advances to help get you settled.

Budaörs is a small city of around 30,000 people, situated at the southern edge of the Buda Hills less than 10km from Budapest. The city offers contemporary architecture, the picturesque old town, breath-taking natural surroundings and historic monuments. You can reach Budapest in a matter of minutes via road or public transport.

title: Swedish Speaking Automotive Warranty Assistant (Opel/Vauxhall)
description:
Swedish Speaking Automotive Warranty Assistant (Opel/Vauxhall)
Location: Budaörs, Budapest, Hungary

Concentrix, a global leader in Customer Service, work in partnership with the prestigious Opel/Vauxhall brand across Europe. We are currently recruiting for Warranty Assistants to join our team in Budaörs, Hungary. Located in state of the art facilities, our team of multilingual experts support a range of languages and assist the Opel/Vauxhall dealer network with the diagnosis and repair of vehicles.

What you can expect day to day:
. Handle warranty claims via phone and email.
. Fully investigating the request using Opel/Vauxhall systems, protocol and procedures.
. Escalating requests that cannot be resolved to other team members, and team leaders located both in the UK and Germany.
. Delivering service excellence by efficiently problem-solving and reacting in a professional, polite and clear manner.
. Accurately logging all Dealer contacts and following up on cases using Opel/Vauxhall database systems.
. Attending team and other meetings for review of issues, assignments, regular discussion.

What we're looking for:
. Automotive knowledge and experience preferred, gained either in a dealership, preferably Opel/Vauxhall, or with an OEM or OEM supplier business.
. Fluency in English & Swedish.
. Previous experience of handling warranty claims preferred.
. Excellent interpersonal skills, able to build constructive & effective relationships, using appropriate rapport,     diplomacy and tact.
. Ability to resolve queries to a high level remotely by telephone/email.
. Opel/Vauxhall product experience preferable.
. Good computer literacy - competent in the main Microsoft Office packages.
. Able to write clearly and succinctly in a variety of communication settings and styles.
. Time management skills, able to use time effectively and efficiently.
. Customer focus, dedicated to meeting the expectations and requirements of internal & external customers.

What can we offer you?
. Bright, modern, exciting place to work with excellent staff facilities
. Multicultural, multilingual environment.
. Excellent relocation package.
. Annual Reward & Recognition Ceremony.
. Professional development opportunities.

Relocating to Budaörs?

If you are relocating we'll help with travel costs, accommodation on arrival and salary advances to help get you settled.

Budaörs is a small city of around 30,000 people, situated at the southern edge of the Buda Hills less than 10km from Budapest. The city offers contemporary architecture, the picturesque old town, breath-taking natural surroundings and historic monuments. You can reach Budapest in a matter of minutes via road or public transport.

title: Erä- ja luonto opas tai muu luontomatkailualan ammattilainen
description:
**Etsin lisää luontomatkailualan ammattilaisia yhteistyöhön kanssani ja osaksi yritykseni Wild Adventures North kasvutarinaa.**

Wild Adventures North on erikoistunut järjestämään villejä seikkailuja suomalaiselle kohderyhmälle. Tarjoamme 10 vuoden kokemuksella autenttisen eräkokemuksen sen kaikessa karuudessaan ja kauneudessaan.

Elämyksiä suunnittelee ja toteuttaa yhteistyössä alan ammattilaisista koostuva tiimi. Toiminta-alueemme kattaa Suomen, Ruotsin ja Norjan upeimmat luontokohteet.

Meille luonnossa liikkuminen on enemmän kuin siirtymistä paikasta toiseen - se on oppimista oivaltamista a yhteyttä ympäröivään luontoon, Opetamme asiakkaalle kaiken, mitä hän tarvitsee - ja vähän enemmänkin.

Tarjontamme on omassa kategoriassaan Suomen laajin: valikoimaamme kuuluu jo 69 erilaista patikka- hiihto-, melonta-, juoksu-, lumikenkä- ja jäätikkövaellusta sekä selviytymiskoulutusta. Meidän kanssamme asiakas voi esimerkiksi:

- vaeltaa koko Suomen Lapin halki kaikkien 12 erämaan läpi

- nousta Suomen korkeimmalle tunturille - ja huiputtaa pikavaellustyylillä kaikki Suomen 33 yli 1000-metristä tunturia

- saavuttaa Suomen ja Ruotsin erämaisimmat pisteet meloa packraftilla niin sileässä vedessä kuin kuohuvissa koskissakin suorittaa Suomen vaativimman kaupallisen selviytymiskokeen, jossa hänet eksytetään helikopterilla viikoksi erämaahan ilman ruokaa, telttaa ja makuupussia - ja käydä ensin siihen valmistavan koulutuspolun

- vaeltaa Pohjois-Norjan jäätikköerämaassa köysistössä, jääraudat jalassa ja hakku kädessä


Yritykseni lähivuosien tavoitteena on laajentaa;

- toiminta uusiin maihin

- markkinointi suomalaisille yrityksille ja lapsiperheille

- elämystarjonta uusiin lajeihin


Jos sinulla on kompetenssia ja ideaa tarttua johonkin näistä kolmesta tavoitteesta, saatat olla etsimäni ammattilainen.

Yhteistyö kanssani tarkoittaa sitä, että olemme yhdessä laatineet välillemme yhteistyösopimuksen, joka mm. määrittelee roolit, tehtävät, vastuun ja potin iaon. Olet yrittäjä, joka laskuttaa yritystäni palveluistaan.

Yhteistyössä kanssani on eri tasoja. Voit olla vieraileva opas, joka tekee yhden tai useamman yksittäisen keikan. Tai voit olla kiinteä osa brändini suojeluksessa toimivaa opastiimiä, joka suunnittelee, testaa ja toteuttaa uusia elämyksiä

Yhteistyö kanssani on kannattavaa, jos et halua rakentaa uutta luontomatkailubisnestä tyhjästä. Pääset hyötymään yritykseni 10 vuoden ajan rakennetusta laajasta asiakaspoolista, näkyvyydestä, vakiintuneesta markkina-asemasta, ryhmäkalustosta ja tiimin vertaistuesta.

Odotan yhteydenottoasi!

title: Prentari / Printer
description:
Prentmet Oddi leitar að ábyrgðarmiklum, nákvæmum og metnaðarfullum starfsmanni til að sinna starfi prentara.
Um er að ræða fjölbreytt og krefjandi starf í öflugu framleiðsluumhverfi þar sem gæði, þjónusta og fagmennska eru í fyrirrúmi.

Helstu verkefni:
Stýra og hafa umsjón með offsetprentvél.
Úttekt og samanburður prófarka og prentarka til að tryggja gæði framleiðslu.
Umsjón með viðhaldi véla og útfylling viðhaldsbókar.
Veita svör og ráðgjöf varðandi prentun og tæknileg atriði.
Umhirða og frágangur vinnuaðstöðu.
Önnur tilfallandi verkefni tengd starfssviðinu.

Hæfniskröfur:
Reynsla af offsetprentun eða sambærilegri framleiðslu er kostur.
Góð tæknileg þekking og hæfni til að vinna sjálfstætt.
Nákvæmni, skipulagshæfni og öguð vinnubrögð.
Jákvætt viðhorf og góð samstarfshæfni.
Áhugi á gæðum og stöðugum umbótum.

Launakjör fara eftir reynslu, þekkingu og hæfni umsækjanda.
Starfið fellur undir kjarasamning Grafíu.
Vinnutími er frá 08:00 til 16:00 virka daga, en til 15:30 á föstudögum.

Um Prentmet Odda:

Prentmet Oddi er stærsti framleiðandi landsins á kartonumbúðum, almennu prentverki og bókum. Félagið vinnur jafnframt með mörgum af öflugustu umbúðaframleiðendum Evrópu til að veita fyrirtækjum heildarlausnir á sviði umbúða. Prentmet Oddi þjónustar meginþorra af kröfuhörðustu fyrirtækjum landsins og hefur gert það í áratugi með hraða, gæði og persónulega þjónustu að leiðarljósi.

Áhugasamir umsækjendur eru hvattir til að sækja um starf á:

🔹 https://alfred.is/starf/prentari-oskast-6

eða

🔹 https://www.prentmetoddi.is/prentmet-oddi/atvinnuumsokn

Nánari upplýsingar má einnig fá með því að senda fyrirspurn á isi@prentmetoddi.is.

Við leitum að einstaklingi sem hefur metnað fyrir gæðum, tæknilega færni og áhuga á að taka þátt í framleiðslu á fyrsta flokks prentverkefnum.
Umsóknarfrestur er til og með 12 september 2026

This is a varied and challenging position within a dynamic manufacturing environment where quality, service, and professionalism are key priorities.

Key Responsibilities:

title: Maintenance technician
description:
We are looking for a Maintenance Mechanic / Maintenance Technician or a mechanically skilled and hands-on person to join our maintenance team in a meat processing plant.

The role involves preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, repairs and general technical support for production machinery and equipment. The employee will work closely with production staff to ensure reliable operation of equipment and minimize production downtime.

Main responsibilities:
Preventive maintenance and servicing of production machinery
Troubleshooting and repairing mechanical faults
Assisting with installation, adjustment and improvement of equipment
Responding to breakdowns and minimizing production downtime
General maintenance work throughout the production facility
Maintenance and repair of slaughter line equipment when required

Qualifications and experience:
Mechanical background or strong practical/mechanical skills
Experience in industrial maintenance, food production or similar environments is an advantage
Experience with food processing and packaging equipment from manufacturers such as Weber, MULTIVAC, K+G Wetter and VEMAG is a strong advantage
Experience with maintenance of slaughter line equipment is an advantage
Ability to troubleshoot mechanical and technical problems independently
Electrical, pneumatic or hydraulic experience is an advantage

Reliable, organized and able to work both independently and as part of a team

Formal education as a mechanic or industrial technician is an advantage, but practical experience and strong mechanical ability will also be considered.

Salary negotiable based on experience, qualifications and education , according to collective agreements

A varied technical role in an active food production environment
Opportunity to work with a wide range of modern food processing and packaging machinery

title: Technical Director
description:
CCP Games is seeking a Technical Director to lead the technical direction of Core Technology and CARBON — CCP's shared game development platform spanning engine runtime, rendering, graphics, tools, pipelines, and developer experience.

In this role, you will set the technical direction for CARBON, ensuring it evolves as a high-leverage, modern platform that creates meaningful value for game teams across CCP. The ideal candidate brings deep game engine expertise across both runtime and tooling, experience in rendering and graphics, a practical belief in AI-assisted development, and a view of open source as both a near-term execution priority and a long-term strategic advantage.

Reporting to the Senior Development Director of Core Technology, you will translate product vision and organizational priorities into clear technical direction and execution. You will directly manage technical leaders across Graphics, Runtime, and Tools, maintaining visibility into the health and opportunities across the department while keeping teams aligned on a coherent engineering direction.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will contribute through architecture, technical guidance, and code review, while focusing primarily on raising the effectiveness and goals of the engineers and leaders around you.

The position is located in Reykjavík, Iceland.

Your Tasks:
